description: Lav afdelingsbudgetter, budgetopfølgning og samlede PDF-rapporter for Bredballe IF ud fra read-only finansdata i Conventus. Brug ved opfølgning for en afdeling eller alle afdelinger, med afvigelser i kroner og procent, foreslåede ratinger og spørgsmål til bestyrelsen.

name: bredballeif-padel-baner
description: Tjek om Bredballe IF Padels baner (SPORT 24, Sydbank, home Vejle) er ledige på en bestemt dato og evt. tidsrum — og book baner. Brug når bestyrelsesmedlemmer spørger om en padelbane er fri. Trigger: ledig bane, er der en bane fri, banebelægning, padelbane, book en bane, ledige tider.

name: bredballeif-padel-conventus
description: Vis medlemmer direkte i en autentificeret Conventus-browser, hent og analyser Bredballe IF-data via XML API eller kontrolleret web-udtræk, og administrer grupper via Conventus-hjemmesiden. Brug til padelmedlemmer, medlemslister, alle medlemmer i en konkret gruppe via gruppe-ID, grupper, medlemstal, churn og retention, redigering eller oprettelse af grupper samt read-only resultatopgørelser og finansdata til budget og budgetopfølgning.

name: bredballeif-padel-halbooking
description: Administrer Bredballe IF Padel-medlemmer i HalBooking via Playwright browser automation. Brug til at søge medlemmer, hente detaljer, se medlemskabshistorik, oprette medlemmer, eksportere medlemmer, tjekke HalBooking preflight og arbejde med HalBooking admin-sider.

name: bredballeif-padel-kontingent-beregner
description: Beregn, validér og diff sæsonvægtede prime- og non-prime-kontingenter for Bredballe IF Padel uden at skrive til Conventus eller andre systemer. Brug når agenten bredballeif-padel-administrator skal justere padel-kontingenter, kontrollere månedlige priser, finde aktiv/inaktiv status for "til og med 30. juni" eller "resten af året", eller returnere struktureret JSON til efterfølgende opdatering via andre skills.

name: bredballeif-padel-onboarding
description: Onboard Bredballe IF Padel-medlemmer og frivillige på tværs af Conventus, HalBooking og Gmail. Brug til fuld SOP: slå person op i Conventus, godkend betalende medlem eller gratis frivillig fra gruppen Padel Frivillige, opret eller find personen i HalBooking, tildel prime/non-prime medlemskab, generer eller send velkomstmail, processer Conventus-notifikationer og kør preflight.

name: bredballeif-vedtaegter
description: Fortolk og anvend Bredballe IFs vedtægter til at afklare ansvar, kompetence, beslutningsgange og administrative pligter for generalforsamlingen, bestyrelsen, forretningsudvalget og afdelingerne. Brug ved spørgsmål om en paragraf, især § 15, om bestyrelsens eller afdelingernes ansvar, eller når en vedtægtsbestemt opgave skal kontrolleres, planlægges eller udføres, fx generalforsamling, afdelingsmøde, årsberetning, handlingsplan, budgetforslag, forretningsorden, medlemsforhold, beslutningsoplæg eller årshjul.

name: bredvid-andra-sessioner
description: Använd i dealer-repot när arbetet startar i en session eller underagent medan andra sessioner skriver i samma repo - innan en fil ändras, en gren eller ett arbetsträd görs, en ny modul under src/ importeras, ett meddelande skickas till en annan session, eller headless Chrome, grafikkortet eller många testarbetare används. Gäller varje session som inte är huvudagenten, och huvudagenten när den delar ut arbete.

name: bredy-anime-reel
description: 브리디 동물(고양이·강아지·크레·햄스터)이 한국 사람 누구나 아는 애니 명장면을 패러디하는 16~25초 릴스·쇼츠를 만든다. 기획 관문(아는 장면·원작 OST·웃음 대비 한 줄) → 비트 단위 콘티 → Veo 클립 생성 → 자막·리듬 편집 → 사용자 미리보기 확인 → 게시까지. 사용자가 '애니 패러디 릴스', '애니 명장면 숏폼', '명장면 동물 버전', '애니 밈 영상 만들어' 등을 요청할 때 쓴다. 매일 유행 밈 영상은 bredy-meme-reel, 매물 홍보 카드는 bredy-sns-promo.

name: bredy-app-deploy
description: 브리디 앱(bredy_app, Expo)을 운영에 내보낸다. JS 만 바뀌었으면 코드푸시(EAS Update)로 바로 내고, 네이티브가 바뀌었으면 Android·iOS 스토어 빌드(EAS 클라우드, Android 한도 소진 시 로컬 빌드)를 만들어 Play 프로덕션·App Store 심사까지 제출한다. 사전 검사, 웹 선배포 확인, 버전·출시 노트, 런타임 기록, 태그까지 한다. 사용자가 '앱 배포해줘', '브리디 앱 배포', '다음 버전 빌드해서 업데이트', '스토어 올려줘', '플레이스토어 올려줘', '앱스토어 제출', 'iOS 배포', '코드푸시', 'OTA 업데이트', '앱 수정 바로 반영' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 웹(breeder_web) 배포는 breeder-web-deploy 스킬, 스토어 스크린샷 디자인은 bredy_app docs/store-screenshots.md 를 따른다.

name: bredy-cafe-activity
description: 브리디 운영자 네이버 계정으로 생물 카페(물생활 홈다리·파충류 파사모·곤충 개미마을)의 최근 질문글에 정보성 답 댓글을 달고, 같은 주제로 네이버 블로그(bredy_team) 정보글을 써서 댓글 끝에 그 블로그 링크를 남긴다(블로그 글 끝에서 브리디로 연결). 질문 고르기 → 본문·댓글 읽기 → 블로그 글 발행 → 카페 댓글 → 기록·보고까지 한다. 사용자가 '카페 활동해줘', '카페 활동', '카페 질문에 답 달아줘', '홈다리 댓글', '파사모 댓글', '카페에 정보 댓글', '카페 영업' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 브리디 앱 안 커뮤니티에 크루 계정으로 글을 쓰는 일은 bredy-crew-activity 스킬, 인스타 DM 영업은 bredy-instagram-outreach 스킬 담당.

name: bredy-cafe-research
description: 브리디 시장조사용으로 네이버 카페(식물·강아지·고양이·물고기·거북이·소동물 등) 최근 글의 제목·본문·사진을 브리디 자동화 크롬(9222) 네이버 로그인으로 수집하고, 카페별 글 수·반응·게시판·많이 나온 말·분양 비중·가격을 집계한다. 종별 대표 카페 찾기 → 활동량 확인 → 수집(글 사이 3~5초, 이어받기) → 잠긴 글 점검 → 집계 보고(report.md)까지 한다. 사용자가 '카페 크롤링', '카페 글 수집', '○○ 카페 30개 긁어줘', '네이버 카페 시장조사', '카페 사진이랑 글 받아줘', '카페 집계' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 카페에 댓글·글을 다는 일은 bredy-cafe-activity, 로봇천국 카페 운영은 robot-cafe-content 담당.

name: bredy-content
description: 브리디(bredy.app) 인스타그램·쓰레드용 마케팅 콘텐츠(카드뉴스 이미지 4:5, 15초 릴스 영상 9:16)를 브랜드 템플릿으로 만들고, 영업 멘트·콘텐츠 캘린더·자동 게시 설계를 다룬다. 사용자가 '브리디 카드뉴스', '브리디 릴스', '인스타 콘텐츠 만들어줘', '오늘 콘텐츠', '쓰레드 게시물', '분양/경매/동네 브리더/혈통 홍보', '마케팅 자동화', '영업 멘트' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다.

name: bredy-crew-activity
description: 브레디 크루(운영 계정)로 반려생활 커뮤니티에 활동한다. 생물 분류마다 정보·댓글·토론·질문 역할을 맡은 크루가 있다. 실행할 때마다 최근 글을 읽고, 역할에 맞는 새 글·찬반 토론과 글 내용에 맞는 댓글·좋아요·팔로우(필요하면 혈통) 계획을 짜서, AI 냄새 검사(lint)와 사람 말투 다듬기를 거쳐 사용자 확인 뒤 API 로 실행한다. "크루 활동", "운영 계정 활동", "커뮤니티 채우기", "크루 글 AI 냄새", "크루 프로필 바꿔"를 요청할 때 쓴다.

name: bredy-feature-flow
description: 브리디(bredy_app 앱 + breeder_web 웹·서버)에 새 기능을 기획부터 출시 직전까지 한 번에 만든다. PRD(docs/prd) → 당근 톤 시안 HTML·PNG(design/mockups) → 지정한 사용자군 페르소나 피드백(서브에이전트) → PRD v2 → 서버·웹·앱 동시 구현(마이그레이션은 migrate deploy 만) → 테스트·웹 E2E·에뮬레이터 캡처 → pr-assets 업로드 → 웹 dev PR + 앱 master 푸시(Parity 트레일러) → 문서·메모리 기록까지 한다. 사용자가 '브리디에 ○○ 기능 추가해줘', 'PRD부터 써주고 기획 디자인하고 만들어줘', '20대 여자(○○ 사용자) 피드백 받아서 만들어', '기획→디자인→구현 다 해줘' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 작은 버그 수정·문구 변경, 배포만(bredy-app-deploy·breeder-web-deploy), PRD 문서만(hjjm-prd)에는 쓰지 않는다.

name: bredy-instagram-outreach
description: 브리디 공식 인스타 계정(bredy_breeder)으로 크레·파충류 브리더·샵·키우는 사람에게만 영업 DM 을 보내고 답장을 처리한다. 브리디 자동화 크롬(scripts/ig.mjs)으로 DM함 답장 정리 → 남은 창립 브리더 자리 확인 → 유형별 공통 문구에 닉네임만 넣어 하루 20명까지 발송 → targets.csv 기록 → 보고까지 한다. "인스타 DM 영업", "인스타 영업 돌려", "DM 보내줘", "인스타 답장 확인", "영업 메시지 보내", "브리더 DM", 아침·점심·저녁 자동 영업 일정 실행 때 쓴다.

name: bredy-kakao-openchat-room
description: 브리디 카카오톡 오픈채팅방(종별 홍보방)을 하나 더 연다. breeder_web 의 종별 소식 문구 기능(`/admin/kakao-digest`, 매일 08시 운영자 푸시)에 방을 추가하고(KAKAO_DIGEST_ROOMS 한 줄), dev DB 읽기 전용 조회로 종 필터를 확인하고, 관리자 화면 캡처와 dev PR 을 만든 뒤, 카톡에서 방을 만들 때 쓸 방 이름·해시태그·공지·방장봇 문구까지 써 준다. 사용자가 '오픈채팅방 추가', '곤충방도 만들어', '물고기 톡방 열자', '카톡방 소식 문구에 ○○ 추가', '오픈채팅 소식 종 늘려', '톡방 공지 써줘' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 소식 기능 자체(문구 형식·조회 기준·크론)를 바꾸거나 카톡 자동 발송 봇을 만들 때는 쓰지 않는다.

name: bredy-overseas-research
description: 브리디 시장조사용으로 해외 반려생활 커뮤니티(미국·영어권 Reddit, 대만 PTT, 미국 XenForo 포럼 TheCatSite·dogforum 등)에서 강아지·고양이·파충류·식물·거북이·물고기·햄스터 글의 제목·본문·사진을 수집하고 사이트별로 집계한다. 종별 사이트 고르기 → 접속 확인 → 사이트 형태별 수집기 실행(이어받기) → 집계 보고까지 한다. 사용자가 '해외 크롤링', '해외 사이트 수집', '레딧 수집', 'PTT 수집', '해외 커뮤니티 시장조사', '외국 반려동물 글 모아줘', '해외에서 ○○ 200개씩' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 네이버 카페 수집은 bredy-cafe-research 담당.

name: bredy-posthog-event
description: 브리디 앱(bredy_app)·웹(breeder_web)에 PostHog 이벤트를 추가·수정한다. 서버 이벤트(captureServerEvent + platform), 웹 클라이언트 이벤트(trackEvent·ANALYTICS_EVENTS), 앱 이벤트(captureAppEvent)를 고르고, 이벤트 이름 등록 → 호출 → jest 목 정리 → 기준표 docs/current/posthog-events.md 갱신 → 웹 PR·앱 master 커밋(Parity 트레일러) → 배포 뒤 PostHog MCP 로 수신 확인·인사이트까지 한다. 사용자가 '포스트호그 이벤트 추가', '이벤트 심어줘', 'PostHog 트래킹', '사용률 보게 해줘', '가입률·전환율·이탈률 측정', '이 기능 몇 명 쓰는지 보고 싶어', '분석 이벤트 넣어줘' 등을 요청하거나 새 기능에 계측을 붙일 때 사용한다. 이미 쌓인 데이터를 분석만 할 때는 PostHog MCP 를 바로 쓰고 이 스킬은 쓰지 않는다.

name: bredy-prod-db-write
description: 브리디 운영 DB(Supabase 'bredy')의 데이터를 몇 행 고친다 — 혜택·뱃지 재부여(창립 브리더 등), 잘못 들어간 값 수정, 특정 행 상태 되돌리기처럼 관리자 화면에 기능이 없는 일. 읽기 전용 계정으로 대상 행을 찾아 보여 주고, 쓰기 계정으로 트랜잭션 미리보기(ROLLBACK)를 한 뒤, 바뀔 행 수가 예상과 같을 때만 COMMIT 하고 다시 조회해 확인한다. 사용자가 '운영 DB 고쳐', '운영 데이터 수정', '○○님 혜택 다시 줘', '창립 브리더 다시 부여', '뱃지 되돌려', '운영에서 이 값 바꿔줘' 등을 요청할 때 사용한다. 스키마 변경(마이그레이션)·dev DB·대량 정리·백업 복원에는 쓰지 않는다.

name: bredy-region-check
description: 브리디 앱(bredy_app)·웹(breeder_web)의 '내 동네 설정'과 '현재 위치로 찾기'를 실제 화면으로 검증한다. 카카오맵 서비스 켜짐 확인, 에뮬레이터 위치(geo fix)·앱 언어(ko-KR) 지정, 쉬는 에뮬레이터 확보와 분담 알림, 워크트리 Metro 연결, 시/군/구 고르기→완료→이전 화면 복귀 확인, dev 테스트 계정의 동네 값 확인·복원, 웹 next dev+Playwright 흐름(저장 요청 가로채기)과 캡처까지 한다. 사용자가 '동네 설정 확인해봐', '현재 위치 찾기 테스트', '위치 설정이 안 돼', '내 동네 버그', '동네 브리더 검증', '우리 동네 화면 확인' 등을 요청하거나 RegionPickerScreen·RegionPicker·locateRegion 을 고친 뒤 확인할 때 사용한다. 동네 기능 자체를 새로 설계하거나 서버 nearby API 만 고칠 때는 쓰지 않는다.

name: bredy-repo-cleanup

description: Benchmarking Universal Single-Copy Orthologs for genome completeness. Use for installation, parameter choice, execution, output interpretation, or troubleshooting.

name: busco

Use when running BUSCO, assessing genome/transcriptome/proteome completeness, scoring against an odb10 lineage, or when the user mentions "BUSCO", "BUSCO score", "completeness", "C/S/D/F/M", "ortholog completeness", "genome/transcriptome/assembly QC", or asks whether an assembly is complete. name: busco-assessor

name: busco-completeness-assessment

name: busco-completeness-interpretation

name: bust-async-without-await
description: `async` functions that never actually `await` anything — synchronous code dressed up in async syntax. The function runs synchronously, blocks the event loop on any slow operation, and gives callers a false sense that it's non-blocking. This is one of the most common AI code generation mistakes.

name: bust-blocking-calls
description: Synchronous blocking calls inside async contexts — reading files, making HTTP requests, or querying databases with sync APIs inside `async def` functions, `async` event handlers, or event loops — stalling the entire event loop.

name: bust-ci-cd-gaps
description: Missing, broken, or toothless steps in the CI/CD pipeline — lint gates that don't enforce, test jobs with `continue-on-error`, missing security scans, and deploy pipelines that can push broken code to production.

name: bust-circular-deps
description: Circular dependency chains — where module A imports B, B imports C, and C imports A — causing import errors, initialization failures, and architectures that cannot be partially loaded or tested.

name: bust-convention-drift
description: A second way of doing something that already has an established pattern in the codebase — two HTTP clients, two error handling strategies, two auth patterns, two ways to write database queries — introduced by AI or a new contributor who didn't check how it was done before.

name: bust-dead-code
description: Unused imports, unreachable branches, zombie functions that are never called, commented-out code blocks, and feature flags that have been fully rolled out but never cleaned up.

name: bust-deploy-risk
description: Deployment practices that make production releases dangerous — no rollback plan, untested migrations, missing feature flags, and deploying directly to production without validation.

name: bust-env-parity
description: "Works on my machine" — mismatches between development, CI, and production environments caused by missing `.env.example`, unpinned tool versions, inconsistent OS behaviour, missing seed data, and dev-only dependencies leaking into production.

name: bust-exposed-internals
description: Sensitive data leaking through error messages, logs, API responses, or debug output — stack traces returned to users, PII in application logs, internal system paths in error responses, and database schemas leaked through verbose errors.

name: bust-flaky-tests
description: Tests that pass and fail non-deterministically — depending on execution order, timing, shared state, external services, or random data — causing developers to re-run CI until they get green, and eroding trust in the entire test suite.

name: bust-formatting
description: Code that violates language-specific style conventions — inconsistent indentation, mixed quote styles, wrong line lengths, and formatting that would be caught automatically by a linter or formatter.

name: bust-framework-antipatterns
description: Code that fights the framework instead of working with it — reimplementing what the framework already provides, bypassing its conventions, or using its primitives in ways they were not designed for.

name: bust-god-objects
description: Classes or modules that know too much, do too much, and own too much — making the codebase impossible to test, extend, or understand.

name: bust-hardcoded-secrets
description: API keys, passwords, tokens, private keys, and other credentials baked directly into source code — where they will be committed to version control and potentially exposed to anyone with repository access.

name: bust-injection
description: SQL injection, command injection, template injection, LDAP injection, and other injection vulnerabilities — where user-controlled input is concatenated into a query, command, or template that is then executed.

name: bust-insecure-defaults
description: Security vulnerabilities introduced by insecure default configurations — open CORS policies, weak cryptography settings, missing authentication, disabled TLS verification, and other cases where the "easy" setup is also the insecure one.

name: bust-legacy-patterns
description: Code that uses outdated language patterns — callbacks where async/await is available, `var` instead of `const`/`let`, string concatenation instead of template literals, and other patterns superseded by modern equivalents that are cleaner and safer.

name: bust-logic-errors
description: Incorrect logic that passes tests and linting but produces wrong results — off-by-one errors, inverted conditions, wrong operators (`&&` vs `||`, `>` vs `>=`), incorrect boundary handling, and silent integer/float precision issues. The #1 category of AI-generated code failure.

name: bust-memory-leaks
description: Event listeners not removed, timers not cleared, closures holding references to large objects, unclosed file handles or database connections, and other patterns that prevent the garbage collector from reclaiming memory.

name: bust-missing-auth-check
description: API endpoints that authenticate the caller (verify *who* they are) but forget to authorise the action (verify *whether they're allowed to do this specific thing*). A logged-in user can read, modify, or delete another user's data by simply changing an ID in the request. AI agents reliably generate authentication middleware but almost never add per-resource ownership checks.

name: bust-missing-db-index
description: Database queries on unindexed columns — causing full table scans that are fast in development (100 rows) and catastrophically slow in production (1M rows). AI agents generate queries without knowing the data volume or access patterns, and almost never add indexes.

name: bust-missing-input-validation
description: API endpoints, functions, and handlers that trust all incoming data without validating it — accepting malformed types, out-of-range values, oversized payloads, or missing required fields. AI agents commonly skip validation because the happy-path logic works on the sample data they're given.

name: bust-missing-observability
description: Production code paths with no logging, no metrics, and no alerting — where failures are invisible until a user reports them, where you can't answer "is this working right now?", and where diagnosing an incident requires guesswork instead of data.

name: bust-missing-pagination
description: Queries, APIs, and data fetches that return unbounded result sets — no `LIMIT`, no cursor, no page size — causing out-of-memory crashes, timeouts, and cascading failures as the dataset grows.

name: bust-missing-tests
description: Critical code paths with no test coverage — business logic that runs without tests, edge cases that have never been verified, and new features shipped without any corresponding tests.

description: Mutable default arguments and shared mutable state that is accidentally shared across all callers — Python's most notorious footgun, and a pattern AI agents reproduce constantly because the code looks correct and passes basic tests. The bug only appears when the function is called more than once.

name: bust-n-plus-one
description: N+1 query patterns — where code executes one query to fetch a list of records and then one additional query per record to fetch related data — causing performance that degrades linearly with the number of records.

name: bust-naming
description: Misleading, abbreviated, cryptic, or non-idiomatic names for variables, functions, classes, and modules — making code harder to read than it needs to be and hiding intent.

name: bust-orm-abuse
description: Misuse of Object-Relational Mappers — both using an ORM where raw SQL would be more appropriate, and writing raw SQL where the ORM would be cleaner and safer.

name: bust-outdated-deps
description: Dependencies that are multiple major versions behind, have known CVEs, have been abandoned by their maintainers, or create transitive vulnerabilities that put the application at risk.

name: bust-over-engineering
description: Solutions that are more complex than the problem requires — abstractions built for hypothetical futures, infrastructure sized for 100x the current load, and patterns applied because they sound impressive rather than because they solve a real problem.

name: bust-pr-hygiene
description: Pull requests that are too large to review, lack context, bundle unrelated changes, or sit open so long they become merge conflict nightmares — all of which lead to superficial reviews and bugs that slip through.

name: bust-race-conditions
description: Check-then-act patterns, non-atomic counter increments, double-submit vulnerabilities, and shared mutable state accessed concurrently — where the gap between "check" and "act" allows another thread or request to invalidate the assumption.

name: bust-stub-code
description: Placeholder, scaffold, or TODO code that was written as a temporary skeleton and accidentally shipped — `throw new Error("not implemented")`, hardcoded return values, `pass` bodies in production paths, and `// TODO: implement` comments in code that is actively called.

name: bust-swallowed-errors
description: Exceptions and errors that are silently caught and discarded — making failures invisible, turning bugs into mystery behaviour, and removing any chance of diagnosis or recovery.

name: bust-tech-debt-hotspots
description: Files and modules that are simultaneously high-churn (changed frequently) and low-quality (low test coverage, high complexity, many bugs) — the areas of the codebase where every change is risky and takes longer than it should.

name: bust-test-quality
description: Two related problems that together make tests useless: tests that exist but verify the wrong things (asserting implementation instead of behaviour), and code that is structurally impossible to test (hidden dependencies, logic buried in I/O, non-determinism). Both produce the same outcome — a green CI that misses real bugs.

name: bust-tight-coupling
description: Components that are so tightly bound to their dependencies that they cannot be tested in isolation, swapped for a different implementation, or reused in a different context.

name: bust-type-safety
description: Type system holes that disable static analysis and allow runtime type errors to slip through — TypeScript `any`, unchecked casts, missing null guards on external data, and Python code that ignores type hints at the boundaries where data enters the system.

name: bust-unnecessary-recompute
description: Expensive computations that are re-run on every render, every request, or every event — when the input hasn't changed and the result could be cached or memoized.

name: bust-wrong-architecture
description: Code structured around an architectural pattern that doesn't fit the problem — making the system harder to understand, extend, and maintain than it needs to be.

name: bust-wrong-framework
description: Using a framework that doesn't match the problem — either too heavy, too light, or simply the wrong tool — leading to unnecessary complexity, fighting the framework, or missing built-in capabilities.

name: bust-wrong-workflow
description: Development workflow practices that slow teams down, introduce risk, or make it impossible to ship safely — including branching strategies that don't match team size, missing CI/CD gates, and deploy practices that have no rollback path.

Use when writing, repairing, or reviewing ANY CadQuery code (parts, assemblies, or proposals). Adapt the closest matching pattern instead of composing from raw API calls.

name: cadquery-export

name: cadquery-export

name: cadquery-llm-skill

name: cadquery-modeling

Use for CadQuery, CQ, 建模, complex models, CAD, drones, robots, vehicles, consumer products, mechanisms, STEP, STL, screenshots, or OCCT-based procedural modeling.

name: cadquery-modeling

Triggers on "before we start, we need to scope this", "do we have enough to go into spec", "clarify this need before we produce anything". description: Cadrage d'une analyse de projet (choix du mode cartographie, rapport ou plans, périmètre, axes, profondeur, inventaire des sources, accès, règles de lecture seule et commandes autorisées). À lire en premier, avant toute lecture du projet.

À implémenter au lot 4.

name: cadrage

À utiliser avant de coder les fonctionnalités d'un site, quand un client exprime ses besoins, ou quand le périmètre d'un site change.

name: cadrage
description: Cadrer une idée avant tout travail. Produit cadrage.md et la chaîne de cartes dans `docs/cartes/`. À utiliser quand le fondateur donne une idée nouvelle.

name: cadrage
description: Ouvre un nouveau chantier — rédige son plan dans docs/chantiers/plan-<nom>.md, découpé en lots livrables, le fait relire par les experts utiles et le soumet à la validation de Quentin avant toute ligne de code. À utiliser quand Quentin lance une nouvelle étape d'envergure du pipeline.

name: cadrage
description: Flow de cadrage interview pour structurer un projet ou une note du carnet. Pose des questions ciblées mappées sur les schémas Zod, génère le fichier typé sur le rail, traite les illustrations déposées dans drop/. Déclencheurs - /cadrage projet, /cadrage note, "cadrer un projet", "nouvelle note", "ajouter un projet".

name: cadrage-acces
description: Cadrage d'une intervention SonarQube et accès à l'instance (choix des missions et du périmètre, modes de connexion au choix, détection de la version, de l'édition et du mode, jeton du compte Sonar en variable d'environnement, appels de lecture libres, appels d'écriture validés, catalogue des appels d'API, analyse sous une branche de travail et outil MCP admis pour l'examen local). À lire avant tout appel à SonarQube.

name: cadrage-audit
description: Audite un existant de projet - cahier des charges, expression de besoin, projet déjà engagé, solution en place, dossier d'appel d'offres - pour en dégager ce qui est établi, les contradictions, les lacunes, les hypothèses implicites et les risques, avant de poursuivre. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur fournit un document ou décrit un projet en cours et demande une relecture critique, un audit, un diagnostic de l'existant ou un avis avant de continuer (requirements review, project audit, tender review). name: cadrage-canon
description: Rédige un cadrage dans le référentiel SSK Canon du projet courant — l'unité de changement datée qui décrit ce qu'on veut faire, pourquoi, et quelles règles de gestion en découlent —, puis propose d'ouvrir le chantier sur les dépôts de code : une issue portant le besoin par dépôt impacté, et le lien retour dans le cadrage. Le référentiel vit dans un dépôt à part, que ce skill trouve seul. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur dit "cadre cette évolution", "rédige le cadrage", "consigne cette décision", ou avant d'ouvrir un chantier dont les règles métier ne sont pas encore posées.

name: cadrage-canon-update
description: Met à jour le skill cadrage-canon — le corriger, l'enrichir, ou le remettre à niveau depuis sa source publiée. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur signale un défaut du skill de cadrage, veut y ajouter quelque chose, ou demande de le mettre à jour. Le skill vit dans ssk-it/ssk-canon-action et non chez le développeur : ce skill-ci dit par où passer pour que les exemplaires ne divergent pas.

name: cadrage-cles-de-voute
description: Cadrer une séquence du dépôt en-ligne-pour-le-cycle-4 avant de l'écrire, puis l'auditer avant de la valider, avec les sept clés de voûte (n°306, 87/311, 337, 343, 346, 347, 348), une checklist de dix-huit questions à réponse vérifiable et une grille sur 100 points où un zéro aux critères 1 ou 2 bloque. À utiliser au début de tout lot, à chaque révision, et pour noter une page après un audit externe.

name: cadrage-depuis-trello
description: Part d'une carte Trello pour rédiger un cadrage dans le référentiel SSK Canon — lit le titre, la description, les checklists, les commentaires et les pièces jointes de la carte, puis enchaîne sur le skill cadrage-canon, repose en commentaire sur la carte le lien du cadrage obtenu et attache à la carte chaque demande de fusion ouverte, et fait suivre l'URL de la carte jusqu'aux issues des dépôts de code. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur donne une URL de carte Trello et demande de la cadrer, dit "cadre cette carte", "cadre ce ticket", ou colle un lien trello.com/c/.

name: cadrage-exigences
description: Formalise les exigences fonctionnelles et non fonctionnelles d'un projet, les règles métier et des critères d'acceptation vérifiables, traçables vers les objectifs, en distinguant ce qui est validé de ce qui reste provisoire. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur demande de rédiger ou compléter des exigences, des spécifications, un cahier des charges, des user stories ou des critères d'acceptation (requirements, specifications, acceptance criteria). Fait partie de la famille cadrage-projet.

name: cadrage-faisabilite
description: Évalue la faisabilité, la viabilité, les risques et la conformité d'un projet sur les plans technique, économique, opérationnel, organisationnel, juridique et temporel, en distinguant conformité présumée, vérifiée et à faire valider, et peut conclure que la faisabilité n'est pas démontrée. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur demande si un projet est faisable ou réaliste, une analyse de risques, une vérification réglementaire (RGPD, normes, obligations sectorielles) ou un avis avant d'engager des moyens (feasibility study, risk analysis, compliance check). Fait partie de la famille cadrage-projet.

name: cadrage-planification
description: Planifie la réalisation d'un projet - découpage du travail, estimations en fourchettes, dépendances, chemin critique, jalons vérifiables - et confronte le plan aux échéances et budgets imposés, sans précision inventée. Propose un planning d'investigation quand la solution n'est pas encore définie. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur demande un planning, un rétroplanning, un calendrier, une estimation de charge, de coût ou de délai, ou veut savoir si une date butoir est tenable (project planning, schedule, estimate, roadmap). Fait partie de la famille cadrage-projet.

name: cadrage-produit
description: À utiliser quand l'utilisateur arrive avec une idée de produit encore floue (« j'ai une idée d'app », « je veux construire… », « on commence un nouveau projet »), ou avant toute nouvelle fonctionnalité importante qui n'est pas dans docs/cahier-des-charges.md. Mène un cadrage par questions posées une à une (problème, cible, alternative actuelle, ce qui rend payant, périmètre V1 limité à une seule promesse) et produit docs/cahier-des-charges.md. N'écrit aucune ligne de code, n'installe rien et ne crée aucun projet avant la validation explicite du cahier.

name: cadrage-projet
description: Cadrer un projet ou une mission avant de produire quoi que ce soit : reconnaissance, risques, dossier de choix argumenté, contradiction entre rôles, brief verrouillable (brief.md), équipe d'agents (equipe.md) et verdict lancer / lancer sous condition / ne pas lancer. C'est la Phase 0 du skill maestro. À utiliser avant toute mission large, ou quand l'utilisateur dit "cadre-moi ça", "avant de commencer", "fais-moi un brief", "est-ce que ça vaut le coup", "on part sur quoi ?".

name: cadrage-projet

Couvre idée ou intuition, problème métier, besoin d'un client, projet informatique ou ERP, transformation, cahier des charges, appel d'offres, projet déjà engagé, solution à auditer. Distingue vérifié, déclaré et supposé, contredit quand c'est justifié, fait valider les décisions par l'utilisateur et tient un référentiel du projet. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur veut lancer, clarifier, cadrer, structurer, reprendre ou réorienter un projet, demande par où commencer…

name: cadrage-projet
description: Utiliser ce skill pour cadrer un nouveau projet avant toute décision technique, au niveau produit et usage, à partir d'une idée brute. L'agent clarifie le problème, l'utilisateur, le périmètre, les fonctionnalités et les points flous, sans proposer de stack, d'architecture ni de specs, et sans écrire de fichier avant validation.

name: cadrage-projet
description: Accompagner un projet du cadrage à la réalisation et aux tests, ou un groupe dans les livrables et la soutenance du cours.

name: cadrage-solutions
description: Explore et compare des options de solution pour un projet sur des critères issus des objectifs et contraintes, y compris conserver l'existant, simplifier, expérimenter ou ne pas poursuivre, puis formule une recommandation justifiée sans favoriser la première idée. À utiliser quand l'utilisateur hésite entre plusieurs solutions, outils, prestataires ou approches, demande laquelle choisir, arrive avec une solution déjà retenue à éprouver, ou demande de vérifier le raisonnement derrière un choix avant de le présenter (solution comparison, options analysis, make or buy). Fait partie de la famille…

L'agent clarifie objectif, utilisateur, périmètre, fonctionnalités et points bloquants, sans proposer de stack, d'architecture ni de specs, et sans écrire de fichier avant validation.

name: cadrage-vertical

Mots-clés — clipper, cadrage, crop, ffmpeg, subprocess, découpe, vertical, visage.

name: cadre-fleet
description: Run a multi-provider, multi-model fleet — fan a task out across several models in parallel (each a specialist with its own role, provider, model, and toolset), then synthesize one grounded, attributed report. Applicable to research, review, analysis, and any task that benefits from cross-perspective grounding. Each run is captured to ~/.cadre/runs/ with a full manifest.

name: cadre-motion-graphics

name: cadre-orchestrator

name: cadrer
description: Prépare un lot (L3–L6) du découpage en plan de vagues exécutables — tâches éligibles, dépendances, branches — sans toucher au découpage lui-même ; à utiliser pour "cadre le lot L3", "prépare la prochaine vague", "par quoi on commence".

name: cadrer-besoin

Triggers : « cadrer le besoin », « audit du besoin », « expression du besoin », « recueil du besoin », « on veut automatiser », « on veut un agent…

Couvre l'exploration du contexte, la verification du perimetre (decomposer avant d'affiner), les questions posees UNE A LA FOIS, deux ou trois approches avec recommandation, la conception presentee section par section avec accord a chaque section, les criteres d'acceptation falsifiables, puis le plan : carte des fichiers avant les taches, decoupage par responsabilite, calibrage d'une tache, contraintes globales recopiees verbatim. A utiliser des qu'un travail depasse quelques heures, qu'on…

name: cadrer-projet-linear

name: cadrer-story

Écrit dans un fichier d'epic, ne code jamais.

name: cadrer-un-chantier
description: Quand un chantier est nouveau ou flou (une stratégie, une méthode, un système, un produit de zéro, un projet) et qu'on veut le cadrer avant de rien lancer → poser le problème, choisir la méthode de réflexion qui convient à la nature de la question, élargir les idées et étudier le marché si c'est un produit de zéro, écrire la méthode et le plan, les attaquer, faire valider une fiche de cadrage à sept cases, puis lancer. Quand un objectif tient en quelques lignes et doit être tenu dans la durée, le workflow rend le système entier en sept sorties. Tout s'écrit dans un dossier `cadrage/`, un fich…

name: cadrer-un-comportement
description: Transformer une demande floue en spécification Forge Watcher rédigeable : choisir la famille et le numéro d'identifiant, dérouler l'interrogatoire qui produit la liste « Règles », et rendre un squelette *Étant donné / Quand / Alors* prêt à coller — ou le constat que la demande n'est pas cadrable en l'état. À utiliser **avant** `docs/specs/`, dès qu'une demande arrive sous la forme « il faudrait aussi notifier quand… », « ça devrait faire… », « et si… », et avant d'ouvrir les skills ajouter-notification, ajouter-une-forge ou etendre-le-port-de-forge.

name: cadrer-un-comportement
description: Transformer une demande floue en spécification rédigeable : choisir la famille et le numéro d'identifiant, dérouler l'interrogatoire qui produit la liste « Règles », et rendre un squelette *Étant donné / Quand / Alors* prêt à coller — ou le constat que la demande n'est pas cadrable en l'état. À utiliser **avant** d'écrire dans `docs/specs/`, dès qu'une demande arrive sous la forme « il faudrait aussi que… », « ça devrait faire… », « et si… ».

name: cadrer-un-projet
description: Use when the user describes something to build that has no ticket and no code yet — a new project, or a feature they state before it exists. Runs three framing stages in conversation and lands the answers in the project sheet, never in a standalone document. Do not use for a question about existing code, for a ticket that already exists, or for a "what if we…" that is not going to be built.

name: cadrer-un-visuel
description: Use when a screen or interface is about to be built and no mockup is referenced — in the ticket or in the project sheet — or when the user asks to mock up, sketch or think through the design of such a screen. Load it BEFORE any mockup tool: it frames the screen in conversation, checks the user's design choices against a short set of UX principles and says so when one is off, settles where the mockup lives, and only then hands the drawing to the mockup tool. Typically raised by `cadrer-un-projet` or `start-ticket`, but also reached directly. Do not use for a pure back-end change, for a fix to…

name: cadri-install
description: Installs Cadri on this machine from cadri.io/docs/installation, cadri.io/docs/joining, or cadri.io/docs/localhost, then seeds or joins memory in the same task. Use when the user pastes a prompt from those docs, or asks to set up, install, or repair the Cadri install. A memory push conflict is cadri-memory-repair.

name: cadri-memory
description: Searches the Cadri team and personal memory books, and edits them when the user asks to remember, forget, or correct something. Use when a prompt says Cadri remembered something, or when editing memory files. First memories after install are cadri-memory-seed or cadri-memory-join. A push conflict is cadri-memory-repair.

name: cadri-memory-join
description: Revises an existing shared Cadri team memory book from the repository the seed window names and from this person's recent sessions, and writes or revises their personal book. Use when cadri init says the team book already has memories, or the joining docs say to fold sessions into the shared book. An empty team book is cadri-memory-seed.

name: cadri-memory-repair
description: Resolves a Cadri memory push conflict or a memory book that will not sync. Use when cadri memory push or the Cadri plugin reports a conflict or a repair. Routine memory reads and edits stay on cadri-memory.

name: cadri-memory-seed
description: Writes the first Cadri team briefing from the repository the seed window names, then team and personal memories from recent agent sessions, when the team book has no lessons yet. Use when cadri init says to follow cadri-memory-seed, or the install docs say to seed memory. A team book that already has topic files is cadri-memory-join.

name: cadrumo-continuidad-grounding
description: Ground or review cross-revision casilla continuity using canonical typed registry data and official AEAT/BOE evidence. Use when assigning a continuidad_id, authoring evolution records, resolving an ambiguous chain, or preparing a continuity worklist.

name: cadrumo-registry-authoring
description: Author and enroll a new AEAT modelo or revision in the union/delta registry, discover the latest official release and filing frame, validate minimal live declarations, and publish the requested authority or export targets. Use for registry release authoring, not private taxpayer filing or harness development.

name: cadrumo-start
description: You must use this skill whenever you are implementing a new feature or orienting yourself in a new session.

name: cads-whole-body-ct-eval
description: Evaluates AI models on voxel-level segmentation of 167 whole-body anatomical structures from CT scans. It probes generalization across diverse imaging protocols, patient demographics, and pathological conditions, with a focus on clinical utility in radiation oncology. Use when the user wants to benchmark on CADS-dataset, 18 Public Benchmark Datasets, or asks about evaluating this task. Reports Dice coefficient.

name: cadsketch
description: Design flat, extruded mechanical parts (plates, brackets, gaskets, spacers, panels) with the user in the CADSketch editor. Draw parts, edit the open sketch in place (move vertices, add and move holes, set driving dimensions, add constraints, undo), look at it with a screenshot, add bosses and pockets on faces, export STL, write and edit .cadsketch files, open .dxf and featuretree .ir.json files, and review what the user has sketched. Use for any request to design, draw, sketch, model, dimension, change or review a part that is a 2D outline with holes, extruded to a thickness.

name: cadsmith-text-to-cad
description: Generates dimensionally exact CadQuery CAD from natural language with the CADSmith multi-agent method — Planner, RAG-assisted Coder, sandboxed Executor, kernel-metric + three-view vision Validator, and Refiner in two nested loops (≤3 error repairs, ≤5 geometric refinements). Use when the user wants a part generated from a text description with verified dimensions, a STEP/STL from a spec, or wants to benchmark text-to-CAD output (Chamfer distance, F1, IoU).

name: cadt-datalens
description: 用 CaDt-DataLens 在 Windows 上为用户打开和查看本地数据文件（JSON/JSONL/YAML/XML/SVG/CSV/TSV/TOML/INI/Markdown/常见代码/图片/二进制），支持命令行直接跳转到指定行:列并整行高亮。当用户要求"打开/查看/预览某个本地文件"、"看第 N 行/定位某行"，或你想让用户在图形界面里检查某个文件时使用。

name: cadt-file-layout
description: 决定 AI 产出的文件放在哪：新建文件、生成报告/网页/导出/草稿、生成或运行脚本、整理或清理目录、给文件命名、用户问「这个存哪」时加载；规定工作区 / .cadt/ / 应用数据三层分区、脚本规范、命名约定、硬禁区与可删除清单

name: cadt-testing
description: Run CADT integration tests, live API tests, and test data cleanup. Use when the user asks to run integration tests, run v1 or v2 tests, run live API tests, or delete test data.

name: cadu-audience-intelligence
description: Pesquisa, qualifica e recomenda audiências do catálogo Cadu por mercado, sinais, funil, geografia, canal e qualidade. Use para segmentação e defesa de audiência; não use para criar perfis inexistentes ou prometer performance.

name: cadu-channel-intelligence
description: Compara e recomenda canais do inventário CentralX usando dados comerciais, audiências compatíveis e formatos disponíveis. Use para shortlist, papel de canal, adequação e validações; não use para montar o plano completo ou ativar mídia.

name: cadu-ecc-fluxo
description: Planejar e verificar slices de software em qualquer tecnologia com especialistas do ECC sob o MIKE, sem acionar todos automaticamente.

name: cadu-ecc-seguranca
description: Revisar segurança transversal do desenvolvimento e agentes Claude Code com ECC, evidências de identidade, dados, infraestrutura, CI e cadeia de suprimentos.

name: cadu-format-intelligence
description: Seleciona e especifica formatos de mídia compatíveis com canal, dispositivo, objetivo e capacidade criativa usando o catálogo CentralX. Use para formato principal, adaptação e checklist técnico; não use para inventar inventário ou afirmar que uma peça foi produzida.

name: cadu-gold
description: Especialista completo para decisões de mídia, públicos, canais e formatos.

name: cadu-media-planning
description: Cria e revisa planos de mídia brasileiros com o método do Smart Planner e os catálogos CentralX de canais, audiências e formatos. Use para definir tese, mix, verba, voo, KPIs, riscos e otimização; não use para comprar ou ativar mídia.

name: cadu-mike
description: Coordenar desenvolvimento pela Engenharia CADU com MIKE, Harness, Loop, Graph, ECC e Claude Code em slices seguros, reutilizando contexto e especialistas.

name: cadu-revisar-plano-de-midia
description: Revisa planos de mídia (XLSX, CSV ou PDF de qualquer agência) com a Cadu Análise. Confere verba, conta de entrega, período, concentração e custos e julga canais, público, funil e mensuração. Use quando a pessoa pedir para revisar, auditar, checar ou dar parecer sobre um plano de mídia. Não use para montar um plano novo.

name: cadu-untangle
description: Fazer diagnóstico estrutural seletivo em português, apenas leitura, e propor slices sob supervisão MIKE; nunca refatorar sem autorização P13.

name: caduceus
description: Resolves as `caduceus:caduceus` after the plugin is loaded on Hermes Agent v0.22.x (minimum tested host). Plugin skills are **opt-in**: they do not auto-trigger. Load with `skill_view("caduceus:caduceus")` when the user asks about the daemon.

name: caduceus
description: Caduceus — bi-directional equivariant long-range DNA language model (Mamba / RC-aware) for long genomic contexts. Use when: (1) Long DNA sequences where transformer gLMs are costly, (2) Reverse-complement equivariant embeddings (Caduceus-PS) or RC-augmented Ph models, (3) Comparing long-range DNA LMs to DNABERT-2 / NT. HF: kuleshov-group/caduceus-*.

name: caduceus
description: Delegate a routine coding task to Hermes Agent in an isolated git worktree, then review its work. Use when the user says "use Hermes", "send this to Hermes", "delegate to Hermes", or when Claude usage is running low and the task is routine coding that has tests. Do not use for design work, debugging across many files, repos without tests, or HyperFrames videos.

name: caduceus-benchmark
description: Caduceus benchmark operator — register, onboard, run evaluations, and submit results to the Caduceus leaderboard

name: caduceus-compile
description: Compile the operator's gap vector into a seat cast, a generated USER.md, and per-seat skill loadouts, then run paired A/B councils against the loadout kill criterion. Use when seats/PROFILE.json changes, when skills land on this machine, when a real decision comes up while the clock runs, or when asked whether loadouts earn their keep.

name: caduceus-council
description: Run multi-seat council deliberations, the believability ledger, the two-person command rule, and the Caduceus dashboard via the `cad` CLI. Use for big decisions, plan competitions, risky-command approvals, and morning briefs.

name: caduceus-guide
description: Answer health and DNA questions from the local Caduceus vault, with sources and honest limits.

name: caduceus-inference
description: Use Caduceus bi-directional equivariant long-range DNA models for Hugging Face masked-language inference, reverse-complement-aware embeddings, pretraining, fine-tuning, and the Long Range Benchmark VEP embedding dump. Use when Codex needs Caduceus-Ph/PS model loading, `vep_embeddings.py`, Hydra `train.py`, `--rcps`, or 131k-token sequence handling.

name: caduceus-report-problem
description: Caduceus: report a bug or problem

name: caduceus-research
description: Run a Caduceus research watch and write its digest.

name: caduceus-session
description: Walk someone through their DNA and health data for the first time, one area per turn, with consent before sensitive results and a clinician brief at the end.

name: caduceus-setup
description: Set up Caduceus — import DNA raw data, a Promethease report, an Apple Health export and health records, then choose privacy and research watches.

name: caducidad-actuaciones-comprobacion-inspeccion-261
description: Redacta el escrito «Caducidad de las actuaciones de comprobación de la Inspección: alegaciones» (formulario 261 de inspección de trabajo y sanciones, revisado el 17-11-2026): pide los datos, decide las opciones, aplica las correcciones y comprueba las normas en el BOE. Requiere Jurisprudenciator.

name: caducidad-actuaciones-previas-itss-declaracion-396
description: Redacta el escrito «Caducidad de las actuaciones previas de la ITSS: declaración» (formulario 396 de inspección de trabajo y sanciones, revisado el 17-11-2026): pide los datos, decide las opciones, aplica las correcciones y comprueba las normas en el BOE. Requiere Jurisprudenciator.

name: caducidad-expediente-solicitud-763
description: Redacta el escrito «Caducidad del expediente: solicitud» (formulario 763 de escritos procesales civiles, revisado el 17-11-2026): pide los datos, decide las opciones, aplica las correcciones y comprueba las normas en el BOE. Requiere Jurisprudenciator.

name: caducidade-marca
description: Conduz o pedido de caducidade de registro de marca por desuso, com fundamento nos arts. 143 a 146 da LPI — tanto para requerer a caducidade (cliente com legítimo interesse) quanto para defender o registro provando o uso (cliente titular intimado). Use quando o operador disser "caducidade de marca", "marca não está sendo usada", "quero derrubar uma marca por desuso", "pedido de caducidade", "fui intimado para provar uso da minha marca", "defender caducidade", "registro caduco", ou descrever marca registrada há mais de 5 anos sem uso comprovado no Brasil. O ônus de provar o uso é do TITULAR (ar…

name: cadunico-api
description: This page used to hold an archived copy of this skill. The archive now lives in the registry's data repository.

name: cadunico-api
description: API CadÚnico via Conecta Gov.br para verificação de elegibilidade

name: cadvisor-container-metrics
description: cAdvisor container resource metrics from Linux cgroups. CPU throttling detection, OOM kill monitoring, memory working set vs cache, network I/O per container, and integration with Prometheus scraping. Sources: google/cadvisor (Apache-2.0).

name: cady
description: Reads the company's context in Cady, then loads the matching skill. Use when the work is a company's sales and outreach, drafting to a person (read the sender's voice pack first), posts, competitors and pricing, tools and integrations, budget, fundraising, filings and hiring, product and engineering work, and company agents. Not for personal tasks or coding with no company context. Requires a Cady account.

name: cady-accounting-method
description: Accounting role card: what this function owns and decides. Load when acting as the Accounting agent or choosing among its skills. Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-accounting-period-close
description: Month-end and period close. Use when: Close the books for a month, quarter or year: reconcile bank, payouts and revenue, clear Suspense and lock. Not for: Preparing a tax return (use `cady-finance-tax-cycle`), budgets or runway, or audit sign-off.

name: cady-company-change-agent-behaviour
description: Change agent behaviour. Use when: Change what agents do: edit a skill, role card, run sequence, tool text or an agent's goal. Not for: Making, scheduling or retiring an agent (`cady-company-manage-agents`), or writing or judging a post or design.

name: cady-company-decision
description: Who decides, and how to record it. Use when: Before a choice or an effect: whether it is decided, who decides, how to test a big call and how to record it. Not for: Gathering the evidence a call needs (`cady-company-evidence`), the weekly goal calls (`cady-company-weekly-review`), or doing the task itself.

name: cady-company-evidence
description: Key questions and behaviour tests. Use when: A decision you own needs evidence: frame its questions, take the cheapest route, pre-register any test of behaviour. Not for: Dashboards, reports or data no decision needs; company goals and strategy (`cady-company-weekly-review`); deciding the answer for another owner; routine delivery whose desired behaviour is clear (`cady-engineering-method`).

name: cady-company-manage-agents
description: Manage company agents. Use when: Create and bind, schedule, review or retire a company agent: whether one is warranted, its design and first task. Not for: Native helpers, subagents, one-off work items and agents on a host that is in contact.

name: cady-company-method
description: Executive role card: its point and key bets. Load when acting as the Executive agent (the outer loop). Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-company-onboarding
description: Set up a company and hand over to its Executive. Use when: A new company has no Cady setup yet: record it from what the owner says and set up its Executive agent. Not for: Designing or taking an agent live (`cady-company-manage-agents`), or building a first offering (`cady-gtm-launch`).

name: cady-company-operations-compliance-register
description: Compliance register and monthly filing review. Use when: What statutory and registry filings the company owes and when (annual returns, confirmation statements, state reports). Not for: Preparing one tax return (`cady-finance-tax-cycle`), submitting any filing or payment, or legal advice.

name: cady-company-operations-contract-checks
description: Contract checks: before signing, after completion. Use when: A contract that commits the company is about to be signed or was just signed: what to settle first and what it starts. Not for: Posts or updates about it, the yearly filing calendar (`cady-company-operations-compliance-register`), general legal questions, or a contract not yet in view.

name: cady-company-operations-inbox-follow-through
description: Inbox follow-through: group, triage, track commitments. Use when: Bounded inbox maintenance or thread triage for follow-through, marketing handling or commitments needing tracking. Not for: Executing a prospect reply (`cady-gtm-reply`), sending or drafting outreach, or reading mail Cady is not given: only the host's connector reads mail. Thread triage remains in scope.

name: cady-company-operations-method
description: Company Operations role card: what this function owns and decides. Load when acting as the Company Operations agent or choosing among its skills. Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-company-operations-people-lifecycle
description: Joiners, movers and leavers. Use when: Plan, track and verify the paperwork and access for a new hire or contractor, a role change or someone leaving. Not for: Running payroll, buying licences, or employment or immigration legal advice.

name: cady-company-operations-requirement-register
description: Requirement register: research, check and record. Use when: Research, independently check and record one compliance requirement as a Cady Projects decision. Not for: Tracking occurrences or events (the calling skill does that), filing, signing or legal advice.

name: cady-company-taste-review
description: Writing craft and taste decisions. Use when: Write or edit a post, article, web copy or other public text, or review a design (judge with the taste check). Not for: Pass/fail checks a script or test can decide (run those first), a direct message to one person, or writing a prompt or skill and changing how agents behave (`cady-company-change-agent-behaviour`).

name: cady-company-weekly-review
description: Weekly review. Use when: The weekly review: assess the company, call every goal and initiative, check bets, hand changes to the orchestrator. Not for: A new company's setup (`cady-company-onboarding`), pushing work along, scheduling or dispatching agents or doing function work.

name: cady-customer-success-lifecycle
description: Customer lifecycle: first value to renewal. Use when: Run one customer account after the sale: onboarding to first value, health, risk, renewal, expansion or cancellation. Not for: Open deals before signature (`cady-sales-deal-motion`), the company's own vendor renewals (`cady-finance-vendor-spend-review`), or message copy alone (`cady-gtm-reply` or `cady-gtm-warm-email`).

name: cady-customer-success-method
description: Customer Success role card: what this function owns and decides. Load when acting as the Customer Success agent or choosing among its skills. Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-design-method
description: Design role card: what this function owns and decides. Load when acting as the Design agent or choosing among its skills. Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-design-wcag-audit
description: Accessibility audit (WCAG 2.2 AA). Use when: Audit a web or app interface against WCAG 2.2 AA with real tools and report ranked, reproducible findings. Not for: Visual direction or layout critique (use `cady-design-method`), functional journey QA (use `cady-qa-method`) or a legal conformance statement (needs a qualified specialist).

name: cady-engineering-debugging
description: Debugging and incident response. Use when: Find and fix the root cause of a bug, failing check or production incident, then the regression test and postmortem. Not for: Rating a bug's severity or triaging a flaky test, reviewing someone's diff (use `cady-engineering-independent-review`) or recurring backlog review (use `cady-engineering-system-cycle`).

name: cady-engineering-independent-review
description: Independent review. Independently review a diff, artifact or decision record: rerun its checks, rank findings and return land, fix or redesign. Use when: a change needs review, before merge or in a later batch, or a decision others will build on before it is acted on. Not for: root-causing a bug, triaging a bug report or running helpers (`cady-orchestrator-goal-pass`).

name: cady-engineering-integrations
description: Integrations. Choose, operate or build a company integration: compare and pick a tool or vendor to connect (the vendor reference), operate a chosen connector (the connector reference) or build one (the build reference). Use when: comparing, choosing or connecting a tool, data source or account. Not for: a purchase or renewal decision on cost (use `cady-finance-vendor-spend-review`).

name: cady-engineering-method
description: Engineering role card: what this function owns and decides. Load when acting as the Engineering agent or choosing among its skills. Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-engineering-system-cycle
description: Recurring system cycle: map, dimensions, routed motions. Use when: Clear a product's engineering backlog in recurring cycles from its goal map, system dimensions and state-routed motions. Not for: One bounded change with clear acceptance (use `cady-engineering-method`) or deciding what to build and for whom (use `cady-product-manage`).

name: cady-finance-budget-review
description: Budget and cost review. Use when: Draft or update a budget or spend allocation, or review last month's spend against it. Not for: Burn, runway and when to cut, posting ledger entries, reserving money or authorizing payment; use `cady-accounting-method` for close work.

name: cady-finance-method
description: Finance role card: what this function owns and decides. Load when acting as the Finance agent or choosing among its skills. Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-finance-runway
description: Burn and runway. Use when: Work out burn, runway months and default alive or dead from actual cash, then decide when to cut and what first. Not for: Drafting a budget or allocation (use `cady-finance-budget-review`), deciding a raise (use `cady-fundraise-raise-plan`), approving spend or moving money.

name: cady-finance-tax-cycle
description: Entity tax and filing cycle. Use when: Plan or review an entity's tax obligations, filing preparation and material strategy changes. Not for: Filing, payment, legal advice, invented jurisdiction rules or a universal daily tax agent; use `cady-accounting-method` for period close.

name: cady-finance-vendor-spend-review
description: Vendor spend review: new purchase or renewal. Use when: Decide whether to buy, trial, renew or cancel a paid tool or vendor: cost, actual use, alternatives and commitment. Not for: Bookkeeping, a finance ledger, payment, provider billing changes, supplier order execution or technical qualification; use `cady-finance-budget-review` for the current budget plan.

name: cady-fundraise-investor-list
description: Ranked investor list. Use when: Decide who to pitch for a round: a ranked list of named investors and partners, sourced, with warm paths. Not for: Deciding whether, when or how much to raise (use `cady-fundraise-raise-plan`), drafting materials, setting terms or contacting investors.

name: cady-fundraise-investor-outreach
description: Investor outreach and updates. Use when: Write to investors: a warm intro request, a personalised first note, round follow-ups, or the monthly update send. Not for: Choosing which investors to pitch (use `cady-fundraise-investor-list`), deciding the round (use `cady-fundraise-raise-plan`) or drafting the deck, memo or update (use `cady-fundraise-raise-materials`).

name: cady-fundraise-method
description: Fundraise role card: what this function owns and decides. Load when acting as the Fundraise agent or choosing among its skills. Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-fundraise-raise-materials
description: Raise materials, data room and investor updates. Use when: Draft or revise an investor memo, deck narrative, data room or monthly investor update for a founder. Not for: Deciding amount, instrument or terms (use `cady-fundraise-raise-plan`), choosing which investors to pitch, sending, or editing the cap table.

name: cady-fundraise-raise-plan
description: Raise plan: amount, instrument, dilution and process. Use when: Decide whether, when and how much to raise (SAFE, note or priced round), model dilution and run the round. Not for: Building the investor list, drafting the deck, memo or update, writing to investors, or legal and tax advice.

name: cady-gtm-calls
description: Sales calls: prepare and follow up. Use when: Prepare for a sales or customer call (account brief, agenda, questions), then record its follow-up and next step. Not for: Dialling, recording audio, cold email, or an unverified call note; use `cady-gtm-warm-email` for a separately authorized message.

name: cady-gtm-channel-plan
description: Channel plan. Use when: Turn accepted persona, offer and chosen channels into channel plays and execution briefs. Not for: Choosing the persona, offer or channel mix; researching parties, writing copy, sending or installing schedules.

name: cady-gtm-cold-email-cycle
description: Cold email cycle. Use when: Write and send cold email to people not yet contacted, using one template per segment. Not for: Engaged parties, partner or organiser business approaches, replies in a live thread, and every follow-up; use `cady-gtm-warm-email` for partner approaches and follow-ups, or `cady-gtm-reply` for inbound replies. Missing verification holds release, not preparation.

name: cady-gtm-events
description: Events: attend or host. Use when: Prepare for or host the event named in the brief to advance the company through real conversations. Not for: Choosing an event or treating an attendee directory as intent.

name: cady-gtm-launch
description: GTM launch session. Prepare a coordinated go-to-market launch from strategy through approved work. Use when: the company is starting a growth motion. Not for: choosing a persona (use `cady-gtm-offer-and-segments`) or drafting outreach.

name: cady-gtm-linkedin-message
description: Social direct message. Use when: Draft a first social DM, LinkedIn connection note or one no-reply follow-up. Not for: Public comments or posts are publishing; email or a reply in a live thread use their own skills.

name: cady-gtm-method
description: GTM role card: what this function owns and decides. Load when acting as the GTM agent or choosing among its skills. Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-gtm-offer-and-segments
description: Offer and persona. Use when: Choose or revise the target persona, offer or message angle from evidence, before a cold cycle and at its review. Not for: Preparing or releasing a message; use `cady-gtm-cold-email-cycle`, `cady-gtm-warm-email`, `cady-gtm-reply` or `cady-gtm-linkedin-message`.

name: cady-gtm-persona-profile
description: Persona profile. Use when: Write or revise one persona's profile (customer, investor, partner or supplier) before positioning, sourcing or copy. Not for: Choosing the offer or promise (`cady-gtm-offer-and-segments`), sourcing a List (`cady-gtm-tam-map`) or preparing a message.

name: cady-gtm-pipeline-pass
description: Warm pipeline pass. Use when: Pass over due tracks of one motion (customer for GTM, investor for fundraising, partner) and their next steps. Not for: Writing one message (use `cady-gtm-warm-email`, `cady-gtm-reply` or `cady-gtm-linkedin-message`) or working one deal in depth.

name: cady-gtm-reply
description: Reply in a live thread. Use when: Answer an inbound reply in a live thread: a question, interest, objection, referral, not now or stop. Not for: First touches and follow-ups to someone who has not replied.

name: cady-gtm-tam-map
description: TAM map. Use when: Find who wants, where they gather: people, communities, prospects, leads, target customers, companies or accounts. Not for: Trigger-only lists or preparing messages; use `cady-gtm-cold-email-cycle` or `cady-gtm-linkedin-message` for outreach.

name: cady-gtm-voice-pack
description: Build or refresh a texture-only voice pack. Use when: Owner sets up or refreshes how their messages sound, or drafts read generic. Builds the pack from their sent messages. Not for: Drafting rules (relationship, substance, ask: `references/outreach-drafting.md`, sender_voice), reviewing or sending outreach (`cady-gtm-cold-email-cycle`, `cady-gtm-warm-email`), company brand voice (`cady-company-taste-review`).

name: cady-gtm-warm-email
description: Warm email and follow-ups. Use when: Write email follow-ups, engaged notes, or partner, organiser and supplier business messages, including first approaches. Not for: A customer cold first touch, a reply in a live thread, or LinkedIn. Missing history is not proof that a party is cold.

name: cady-marketing-method
description: Marketing role card: what this function owns and decides. Load when acting as the Marketing agent or choosing among its skills. Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-marketing-post
description: Post one piece. Use when: Create or edit one post for the audience, topic and placement chosen in the brief. Not for: Choosing a content strategy, pillars or distribution plan.

name: cady-orchestrator-challenge
description: Challenge a result by its stakes. Use when: Reading a result one level down before accepting it, as the orchestrator. Not for: Independent review before a merge (cady-engineering-independent-review), the Executive's own decisions, or redoing the work.

name: cady-orchestrator-goal-pass
description: Orchestrate the company. Use when: A due orchestrator pass, or an event: a run finished, an ask answered, a handover returned or a family trigger. Not for: Function work or redesigning an agent (the Executive's).

name: cady-orchestrator-method
description: Orchestrator role card: its point and key bets. Load when acting as the company's orchestrator (the inner loop across families). Not for doing a task: load the task skill.

name: cady-product-customer-interview
description: Customer discovery interviews. Use when: Plan, run and synthesise customer discovery interviews about past behaviour, without leading questions. name: canton-daml-authorization

description: 仅在用户明确要求 CARLA Shipping 打包或运行 package.sh 时执行 build/cook/stage/archive/package；最终包必须由正式主分支生成，发布另行授权。

name: carla-camera-depth
description: 配置 CARLA 深度相机并解码 RGB24 深度；用于距离图、深度单位、原始图与灰度显示差异、Linux 深度材质排障。

name: carla-camera-dvs
description: 配置 CARLA DVS 事件相机并解码时间、像素和极性；用于正负阈值、噪声、不应期、稀疏事件及无事件窗口诊断。

name: carla-camera-fisheye
description: 配置 CARLA fisheye 相机；用于 Kannala_Brandt、Conti、Equidistant、Scaramuzza 投影、k1–k6、cube face、拼接和 ImageCube 输出解码。

name: carla-camera-instance
description: 配置 CARLA 实例分割相机并核对语义与实例编码；用于同类目标分离、实例掩码和跨帧身份边界，避免将像素 ID 当作 Actor.id。

name: carla-camera-normals
description: 配置 CARLA 法线相机并正确读取颜色编码法线；用于表面方向图、法线显示和坐标空间核验，识别 Image 模板别名而非虚构 NormalsImage Python 类型。

name: carla-camera-optical-flow
description: 配置 CARLA 光流相机并读取二维 float32 流；用于帧间运动、光流数值与彩色显示差异，避免按 BGRA 或物理速度解码。

name: carla-camera-rgb
description: 配置和采集 CARLA RGB 相机；用于内参、镜头畸变、曝光、后处理、BGRA/YUV 输出及 Python 图像回调诊断。深度、标签和事件相机走各专项。

name: carla-camera-semantic
description: 配置 CARLA 语义分割相机并导出类别标签；用于原始类别 ID、CityScapesPalette、标签颜色和自定义分类核对。实例身份另走 instance 相机。

name: carla-camera-stereo
description: 配置 CARLA stereo 相机并处理成组左右图、左深度和视差；用于基线、enable_depth、uint16 单位、格式与组内帧一致性。

name: carla-capture
description: 执行有界 CARLA 原始数据采集，管理 warmup、frame/timestamp、超时和清理；用于抓样本或多传感器同步采集。CLI 当前支持 RGB/RayCast 单传感器，其余采集按原生流程；数据解释与研究判断分别交专项。

name: carla-carsim
description: 启用 CARLA CarSim 插件 simfile、切换 CarSim 道路模型并核对后端失败；依赖安装/构建与 server 可读 simfile，UDP CarSim 走独立入口。

name: carla-carsim-udp
description: 配置 CARLA CarSim UDP peer IP/port、substep 与状态回传；用于该专属外部动力学协议接入，须核对 peer、构建和报文，不与其他 UDP 后端混称。

name: carla-chrono
description: 用 CARLA 条件支持的 Chrono vehicle/powertrain/tire JSON、base path 与 substep 切换动力学；需 server 的 Chrono 构建和模型资产，不管理其他后端。

name: carla-clock
description: 管理 CARLA 同步/异步、固定步长、物理 substep、有界 tick 和回调，以及定制 pause/free tick；用于帧不推进、步长不一致或双 tick owner 问题。

name: carla-cluster
description: 核查 CARLA Cluster 成员注册、heartbeat、类型化消息与 RPC 连通；只覆盖协议组件，不承诺完整多机或 multiGPU 调度。

name: carla-collision-sensor
description: 监听和解释 CARLA 碰撞事件；用于碰撞双方、normal_impulse、事件去重与碰撞/overlap 通道排障，不用于提前避障或连续距离流。

name: carla-compare
description: 离线比较已有 CARLA 研究 run，核对冻结输入、原始产物与独立配对后重算结果；用于检查改善、波动或证据篡改。不启动仿真、不补跑、不应用获胜参数。

name: carla-connection
description: 诊断 CARLA profile、指定 Python wheel、client/server 版本、timeout 与 ready；用于首次连接、连接拒绝、解释器或版本不匹配。进程启动停止交 carla-server。

name: carla-content-sync
description: 核实或同步 CARLA Unreal Content 的来源、版本配对与目标路径；用于资产缺失和代码资产不匹配，不触发构建或 Editor。

name: carla-counterfactual-eval
description: Evaluates the quality and feasibility of model-agnostic counterfactual explanations generated for tabular data. It probes whether generated counterfactuals successfully flip classifier predictions while maintaining sparsity, proximity, actionability (immutable constraints), and plausibility across multiple binary classification tasks. Use when the user wants to benchmark on adult, COMPAS, Give Me Some Credit, HELOC, Irish, Saheart, Titanic, Wine, or asks about evaluating this task. Reports Success rate.

name: carla-dataset
description: 将已有 CARLA capture 原始文件、帧身份、标定和真值组织成可追溯数据集，检查配对与缺失；用于离线导出或整理训练样本。不会为了补数据自动运行仿真。

name: carla-debug
description: 使用 CARLA DebugHelper 标绘、调试模式、UE console 与主/次服 console 诊断；不代替专用 debug-port 协议，不把任意 console 文本当作已验证操作。

name: carla-debug-port
description: 核查或使用 CARLA DebugPort UDP 的 ConnectTest/List/Data 协议、port/magic 与 console 回应；查询与执行分别授权，不代替普通 DebugHelper。

name: carla-display
description: 管理 CARLA quality、窗口和 secondary HDMI/device/Xserver sensor viewport；用于本地或多显示设备显示，依赖显示环境与插件，不负责 sensor 原始采集。

name: carla-dos-eval
description: Evaluates end-to-end autonomous driving agents on route completion, safety/infractions, and occlusion-aware perception in simulated urban environments. Use when the user wants to benchmark on CARLA Town 05 Long, DOS Benchmark, or asks about evaluating this task. Reports Driving Score (DS).

name: carla-dspace-udp
description: 配置 CARLA Dspace UDP peer IP/port、substep 与状态回传；用于该专属外部动力学协议接入，须核对 peer、构建和报文，不与其他 UDP 后端混称。

name: carla-editor-launch
description: 启动已有 CARLA Unreal Editor、打开指定项目或地图；用于 launch-only，不编译过期目标，缺二进制时交 build-editor。

name: carla-environment-setup
description: 定位或准备 CARLA UE5 的 OS、编译工具、UE fork、Python 与依赖；用于安装前检查或明确要求的环境安装，不用于直接构建和启动。

name: carla-evaluation
description: Plans and diagnoses TransFuser CARLA 0.9.10.1 evaluation, Longest6 runs, result parsing, checkpoint inspection, and guarded Docker submission packaging without launching external runtimes.

name: carla-excavator
description: 配置 CARLA Excavator bucket/load、挖点卸点和装载速度，启动停止作业并绑定自有 MiningTruck；不替代矿卡行驶或完整土壤物理模拟。

name: carla-fbx-import
description: 准备或导入 FBX 地图/props package JSON，核对导入设置与 UE5 适配；用于工程资产导入，不走 runtime import_asset、USD 或 Houdini。

name: carla-gltf-load
description: 核实并使用 WITH_GLTF 条件下的 GLB static mesh/车辆加载路线；不泛化为任意 glTF 地图导入，不代替 factory 注册。

name: carla-gnss
description: 配置 CARLA GNSS 并解释经纬高、噪声/偏置与地图地理参考；用于地理坐标观测，避免声称具备卫星遮挡、多径或完整 GNSS 传播模型。

name: carla-ground-truth
description: 读取 CARLA WorldSnapshot/ActorSnapshot/Timestamp，配置 listen_actors 与 GroundTruthOutput 的 OASIS 发布边界；不与 target sensor 或 OSI protobuf 混称。

name: carla-houdini-import
description: 把已有 Houdini 导出 actors 接入 CARLA large-map sublevels 并校正 tile 坐标；不执行外部 Houdini 建模或 graph。

name: carla-imu
description: 配置 CARLA IMU 并解释加速度、角速度与 compass；用于各轴噪声/偏置、单位、sensor 坐标、重力与初始差分瞬态，不负责融合定位。

name: carla-lane-invasion-sensor
description: 监听 CARLA vehicle 越线事件；用于车体边界穿过车道标线、crossed_lane_markings 与客户端计算排障，不按服务端连续传感器流诊断。

name: carla-large-map
description: 在 Editor 生成或整理 CARLA main map、tile maps 和 tile 元信息；不处理运行时 streaming 策略、navmesh 或完整打包。

name: carla-leaderboard-eval
description: Evaluates autonomous driving agents on their ability to navigate complex urban environments while balancing route completion, safety, and rule compliance. It probes how well models handle dynamic traffic interactions, edge-case scenarios, and physical constraints in a closed-loop simulation. Use when the user wants to benchmark on CARLA Leaderboard 2.0 scenarios, CARLA 42 Routes, Town05, or asks about evaluating this task. Reports Driving Score (DS).

name: carla-lidar-at128
description: 配置 CARLA CPU AT128 LiDAR；用于三组扫描资产、256 点分块、MemsLidarMeasurement、时间/CRC 与 UDP 包核对。GPU AT128 预设另走 sc_lidar。

name: carla-lidar-gpu
description: 配置 CARLA SceneCapture GPU LiDAR；用于 mechanical、AT128、M1、Pandar64 预设、扫描资产、CPU/GPU 噪声以及 stream/UDP 输出边界。

name: carla-lidar-mems
description: 配置 CARLA 定制 MEMS LiDAR；用于 CSV 扫描轨迹、运动畸变、beam index、距离噪声及 MemsLidarMeasurement 采集。要求 custom-mems 能力和真实扫描资产。

name: carla-lidar-raycast
description: 配置和采集 CARLA 标准 RayCast LiDAR；用于通道、扫描频率/FOV、dropoff、BRDF、距离噪声和 XYZI 点云解码。semantic、MEMS、AT128、GPU 路径另走专项。

name: carla-lidar-semantic
description: 配置 CARLA semantic LiDAR 并解码几何、入射角和对象标签；用于 point/cos_inc_angle/object_idx/object_tag，避免当作 XYZI 点云。

name: carla-longest6-town05long-eval
description: Evaluates an autonomous driving model's ability to navigate complex urban and highway environments under varying weather and lighting conditions, focusing on route completion, safety (infraction avoidance), and overall driving performance. Use when the user wants to benchmark on CARLA Longest6, CARLA Town05 Long, or asks about evaluating this task. Reports Driving Score (DS).

name: carla-map
description: 查询 CARLA spawn points、Waypoint、道路车道拓扑、junction、crosswalk 和地理坐标，导出 OpenDRIVE 或地图缓存；不控制车辆或信号相位。

name: carla-map-cook
description: 在已有 CARLA Editor 工具链中仅 cook 指定地图并核对 cooked 输出；用于 single_map_package.sh，不声称生成独立可分发地图包。

name: carla-map-dressing
description: 离线布置 CARLA 地图的植被、misc actors、ROI、水体或 weather actor 并保存；实时天气与灯光操作走运行时 skills。

name: carla-map-landmarks
description: 按 CARLA OpenDRIVE 标志 ID、类型、方向、有效车道或 Waypoint 距离查询 landmark 并映射运行时标志；动态灯态与相位归 traffic-signals。

name: carla-map-materials
description: 独立恢复已导入 CARLA 地图的语义目录、road painter/decals 和 cook 前地图准备；不重导全部 FBX，不编写 shader 或打包。

name: carla-map-optimize
description: 审计 CARLA 地图 mesh/material/asset/tag/path，筛选重复对象或在明确范围内做 ISM 合并；性能改善须另有 benchmark。

name: carla-mining-truck
description: 读取和配置 CARLA MiningTruck 容量、载荷、举升/下降耗时及 bucket/overall/driving state，执行 lift/lower；道路行驶与挖掘机联动作业分流。

name: carla-navigation-agent
description: 使用 BasicAgent、BehaviorAgent 或 ConstantVelocityAgent 的目的地、global plan、local planner/PID 进行有界客户端导航；不与 Traffic Manager 或手动控制同时接管车辆。

name: carla-navmesh
description: 从 CARLA 场景碰撞或 FBX/OBJ 与 XODR crosswalk 生成 Walker 导航 bin；不生成 TM 路网，旧 tiled Recast 路线不支持。

name: carla-no-crash-eval
description: Evaluates autonomous driving agents' robustness and generalization in a simulated urban environment, specifically testing performance on familiar and unseen town layouts. Use when the user wants to benchmark on CARLA NoCrash benchmark, or asks about evaluating this task. Reports Driving Score.

name: carla-obstacle-sensor
description: 配置 CARLA 前方障碍探测事件；用于检测距离、sweep 半径、only_dynamics 和障碍事件距离，区别于已经发生的 collision。

name: carla-onboarding
description: 带新手按具体目标学习 CARLA，从真实连接、世界观测到一次有界操作并解释结果；用于入门、理解仿真时间或认识传感器。普通任务直接使用领域 skill，不强制上完整课程。

name: carla-opendrive-authoring
description: 检查和接入 Editor 的 OpenDriveToMap ODR/tiles 制作路径；本基线道路网格/标线生成有空实现，不承诺完整 ODR→地图制作。

name: carla-opendrive-world
description: 将 OpenDRIVE 导入或生成 CARLA world，管理生成地图名、删除及程序化树木建筑；用于 XODR runtime 世界，不负责 OSM 转换或 Editor 离线制图。

name: carla-osi
description: 配置 CARLA OSI GroundTruth/TrafficUpdate 的对象、道路、逻辑车道与环境映射，核对 protobuf 版本和外部接收边界；不假定所有 OSI 字段完整或 ROS2 已连通。

name: carla-osm-conversion
description: 使用条件编译的 Osm2Odr 将 OSM XML 转为 OpenDRIVE，配置投影、偏移、道路过滤与信号生成；转换结果交 opendrive-world，不承诺道路运行正确。

name: carla-parameter-search
description: 按冻结计划编排 CARLA 有限参数候选、独立重复与确认、预算和停止恢复；用于已授权的 Auto Research。复用基础采集，不自动改源码、构建、发布或把获胜参数写为默认。

name: carla-perfect-control
description: 启用 CARLA perfect movement backend 及其 substep，执行定制状态/轨迹控制并检查默认后端恢复边界；不宣称该模型具有真实动力学。

name: carla-prop-assets
description: 把已有 StaticMesh 注册成 static.prop.* 并保存 factory/package JSON；用于 prop 资产注册，不负责运行时 spawn/control。

name: carla-radar-mmwave
description: 配置 CARLA 毫米波雷达信号模型；用于载频、功率、天线增益、热噪声、SNR、角分辨率、延迟及目标检测字段，识别未实现的常量置信度/测高。

name: carla-radar-oasis
description: 配置 CARLA Oasis 目标级雷达；用于遮挡筛选、目标数量、坐标方向及目标位姿/速度/尺寸/RCS 输出，避免与普通射线雷达或 target 真值混用。

name: carla-radar-raycast
description: 配置 CARLA 射线雷达并解码径向速度、方位、仰角和距离；用于 FOV/range/points_per_second 与 RadarMeasurement 点检测，不处理 Oasis 目标级结构。

name: carla-real-traffic-scenarios-eval
description: Evaluates the ability of reinforcement learning policies to execute tactical driving maneuvers (e.g., lane changes, roundabout navigation) in a simulated environment mapped from real-world traffic data. It probes how observation modalities and reward structures impact policy generalization and success rates across diverse driving scenarios. Use when the user wants to benchmark on NGSIM, openDD, or asks about evaluating this task. Reports success rate.

name: carla-recorder
description: 使用 CARLA recorder 文件录制、查询碰撞/阻塞并按时间回放，设置 follow/sensor replay/倍速/ignore/keep_actors；原始 sensor 文件采集仍走 capture。

name: carla-replay-parity
description: Review CARLA replay parity evidence with scenario, replay, metric, and limitation tracking.

name: carla-research
description: 兼容旧 carla-research 入口，仅在显式指定旧名称或研究意图尚未细分时使用；按目标路由到实验设计、固定测量、只读比较或有限参数搜索。

name: carla-research-plan
description: 把 CARLA 实验问题转成冻结 workload、允许变量、有效性与比较条件、独立确认和预算，并离线校验计划；不因设计实验自动启动仿真。执行和候选搜索交 benchmark/parameter-search。

name: carla-ros2-native
description: 在已有支持 ROS2 的 CARLA 二进制上配置 native sensor stack、publisher 与 RViz；顶层 Ros2Native 接线被注释时报告条件缺失，不改走外部 ROS bridge。

name: carla-route-planning
description: 用 CARLA GlobalRoutePlanner 的 topology、采样图和 A* 生成 Waypoint/RoadOption 路径；用于起终点路线、道路分叉与换道连接，不直接驱动车辆。

name: carla-rss
description: 配置 CARLA 条件编译 RSS 感知与控制约束链；用于 RssResponse、路由目标、ego/other dynamics、actor constellation 和 RssRestrictor，要求匹配 RSS 构建与依赖。

name: carla-runtime-assets
description: 管理 CARLA runtime 文件基目录、required files 下载、request_file、import_asset 与 static mesh 存在性检查；不负责 UE 资产制作、cook 或发布。

name: carla-scenario-build
description: Turn prepared actor-specific test-case targets into runnable, verified CARLA scenario configurations and one recorded run per case attempt. Use for scenario_pipeline step 5 after scenario-coverage-cases. Does not judge legal compliance, perform the repository's structured scene-graph extraction, or resolve judgment-call thresholds; those are separate downstream tasks receiving this skill's artifacts.

name: carla-scene-lights
description: 使用 CARLA LightManager 的灯组、颜色、强度、active 状态和批量灯态，管理日夜循环；车辆灯与交通灯分别由 accessories/signals 负责。

name: carla-scene-materials
description: 构造 CARLA Color/FloatColor 纹理并应用到自有 actor 或授权对象的 diffuse/emissive/normal/ARM 通道；不制作 UE 材质资产，World 旧贴图入口为 deprecated。

name: carla-scene-objects
description: 查询 CARLA 环境对象 label/ID/name/transform/bbox、level BB 和 static objects，按授权启停指定环境对象；动态 actor 生命周期与射线查询另走专项。

name: carla-scene-query
description: 使用 CARLA cast_ray、project_point、ground_projection 查询带标签几何命中；用于位置投影与可见几何检查，不替代真实 sensor 数据或道路 Waypoint 语义。

name: carla-semi-truck
description: 识别 CARLA 半挂车辆、读取 trailer transform 与 articulation angle，绑定自有 sensor 到拖车；车辆行驶交通用控制，不承诺任意拖车创建/连接接口。

name: carla-sensor-extension
description: 开发新 CARLA sensor 的 UE definition、数据 serializer/registry 与 Python binding 全链路；使用现有 sensor 走对应专项。

name: carla-sensor-rig
description: 配置 CARLA 传感器的父对象、安装位姿和组合布局，挂载或拆卸自有 sensor；用于安装多传感器、调整外参。各传感器物理参数和解码转对应专项，数据采集转 carla-capture。

name: carla-sensors
description: 兼容旧 carla-sensors 入口，仅在显式指定旧名称或尚未确定传感器类型时使用；按请求路由到具体传感器专项或 carla-sensor-rig。

name: carla-server
description: 启动和停止用户指定的已有 CARLA Shipping 包，核实端口、进程身份、日志与 RPC ready；不编译打包，不接管借用实例。

name: carla-session
description: 打开、关闭 CARLA Agent 独占 session，保存 settings、跟踪资源与 episode 并恢复；用于已授权多步操作的生命周期管理，不负责 server 进程或换图。

name: carla-simulink-udp
description: 配置 CARLA Simulink UDP peer IP/port、substep 与状态回传；用于该专属外部动力学协议接入，须核对 peer、构建和报文，不与其他 UDP 后端混称。

name: carla-spectator
description: 读取或移动 CARLA spectator、配置 ego follow/role/reclaim 观察视角；不创建训练 camera sensor，显示器和 secondary viewport 配置交 display。

name: carla-target-sensor
description: 配置 CARLA target 局部目标传感器；用于视域/遮挡、目标运动学、车道多项式、交通灯及端口输出，区别于全局真值、Oasis 雷达和 OSI。

name: carla-terrain
description: 处理 CARLA Editor heightmap 地形、tile 接缝与碰撞重算；不把空 CreateTerrain 方法或保存成功当作可驾驶性验证。

name: carla-tm-map-cache
description: 根据指定 XODR 生成 Traffic Manager 的 in-memory map binary/cache；不生成 Walker navmesh，也不运行旧 UE4 全量 import。

name: carla-traffic-manager
description: 配置 CARLA TM port/autopilot、sync/seed/hybrid/dormant respawn、速度距离换道碰撞规则及 path/route/action buffer；不做地图路线搜索或交通灯相位控制。

name: causal-inference
description: Identification review for observational and quasi-experimental causal claims. name: causal-inference
description: Hybrid causal reasoning protocol: LLM proposes the causal graph structure, symbolic libraries (DoWhy, causal-learn) execute identification and estimation, LLM interprets results in context. Use for counterfactual queries ("what would happen if X were different?"), treatment effect estimation, and root-cause analysis where correlation is insufficient. Distinct from reasoning (which is deductive/inductive, not causal) and deep-research (which gathers web evidence, not causal estimates).
