name: causal-inference
description: Grades a causal sentence on an evidence ladder: explicit contrast and timeline, rival explanations, an intervention or stated identification assumptions, a mechanism chain with recurrence-prevention evidence, and a separate step for responsibility; each rung unlocks its wording — no rung, no word. description: 一个跨阶段、多会话的CBT治疗宏观框架，按问题理解→概念化与目标设定→认知行为干预→巩固与预防复发四阶段组织10次住院心理治疗。

name: CBT复发应对卡制作
description: 指导来访者制作个性化应对卡，明确写出咨询结束后若问题反复时的具体应对步骤、潜在阻碍识别及资源调用方式，强化其独立解决问题的能力与掌控感。

name: CBT复发预防与家庭协同巩固协议
description: 在治疗终期（第8–9次）结构化会谈中，同步开展个体技能巩固与家庭系统干预：引导患者归因进步、复习技术、建立自我效能；联合家庭成员强化情感联结、澄清出院担忧、学习运用CBT技术应对日常问题，并共同制定可操作的复发预警与响应计划。

name: CBT复发预防结构化收尾
description: 在咨询结束期（倒数2–3次），系统引导来访者结构化回顾CBT学习历程，将行为/情绪改善显性联结至认知重构与行为实验原理，协同共建具象化、可观察的个性化复发征兆信号清单，并分层制定三级应对策略（自我调节→支持系统启动→专业求助触发），最终锚定一项SMART原则校验通过的未来90天行动目标，以巩固疗效、增强自我管理能力、降低复发风险。

name: CBT家庭作业布置
description: 引导来访者识别不合理信念，按'更灵活、更现实、更具适应性'三原则共同构建可操作的合理信念，并书面记录。用于巩固认知重构效果，促进行为迁移。

name: CBT家庭作业布置与跟进
description: 在CBT咨询中，系统性布置并结构化跟进家庭作业，以促进认知重构与行为改变的泛化。适用于已建立工作联盟、完成初步评估、进入正式干预阶段的来访者。

name: CBT家庭作业结构化布置
description: 在咨询末尾，针对当次核心认知主题，布置具身化、可记录、可复盘的简明作业，聚焦‘觉察—记录—归因’三要素，为下一次认知工作提供实证素材。

name: CBT导向的复发预防应对卡制作
description: 指导来访者在咨询结束阶段制作个性化‘应对卡’，以结构化方式明确问题反复时的具体行动步骤、潜在阻碍识别及替代应对策略，从而具象化复发预期、降低不确定性焦虑，并锚定其已掌握的CBT能力资源。

name: CBT导向的焦虑状态初步评估协议
description: 在首次1–2次咨询中，整合共情、积极关注与结构化问题澄清，快速聚焦就业压力、失眠、忧虑等核心症状群，形成‘焦虑状态’工作诊断，为后续CBT干预提供靶点依据。

name: CBT导向的认知重构引导对话
description: 在建立基本信任后，聚焦识别并挑战学生持有的核心消极自动思维（如‘人生已经烂透了’），通过苏格拉底式提问、证据检验、认知扭曲命名与替代性想法生成等CBT技术，促使其检验思维真实性并发展更平衡、具实证基础的认知灵活性。

name: CBT导向的阶段性咨询方案制定协议
description: 在第二次咨询中，基于心理测验结果与日常观察，协同求助者共同制定含近期目标与远期目标的咨询计划，并明确以合理情绪疗法为主、系统脱敏与放松疗法为辅的方法组合。适用于已完成初评、需锚定干预方向且具备目标协商能力的个案。

name: CBT就业焦虑三阶段咨询框架
description: 一个结构化、时间限定的三阶段CBT干预流程，专用于大学生就业焦虑问题，覆盖认知重构、行为激活与巩固结束三个核心阶段。

name: CBT工具移交与泛化训练
description: 在咨询终止阶段，系统性地将CBT核心工具（三栏表、思维记录表、箭头向下技术、行为实验、双重故事）移交来访者，引导其识别适用情境，鼓励持续收集支持新信念（如‘我有我价值’‘我有能力’）的实证，并付诸行动，以实现技术自主迁移与日常泛化。

name: CBT巩固与防复发阶段结构化流程
description: 在咨询末期（第11–12次）系统开展效果巩固、技能迁移与复发预防的标准化会话流程，适用于已完成核心CBT干预且症状显著缓解的来访者。

name: CBT强迫症三阶段短程干预框架
description: 结构化8次CBT咨询流程，按评估性会谈→咨询性会谈→巩固性会谈三阶段推进，整合悬搁接地技术与认知行为策略，专用于强迫症伴轻度抑郁状态、具自省力与作业执行力的成年来访者。

name: CBT心境检查与认知三角心理教育
description: 在每次咨询起始进行心境评分与情绪命名，并同步引入认知三角模型（情境-想法-情绪-行为），作为心理教育锚点，帮助来访者建立对认知-情绪关联的元认知觉察。

name: CBT思维-情绪关系 psychoeducation
description: 向来访者简明解释认知行为疗法中事件、思维与情绪三者之间的因果关系，帮助其建立初步的元认知觉察框架。用于咨询初期建立治疗联盟和心理教育基础。

name: CBT技能归因与生活化迁移训练
description: 在咨询结束阶段，将来访者在咨询中习得并实践的CBT工具（如三栏表、箭头向下、双重故事）明确归因于其自身能动性与选择，并协同其识别72小时内可及的真实生活情境，设定微小、可验证的行为证据收集任务，以支持新核心信念（如‘我有我价值’‘我有能力’）的持续内化与行动化。

name: CBT放松训练：网络疑病相关自主神经调节
description: 在个案干预中段，针对网络疑病诱发的自主神经高唤醒状态，系统引导来访者习得并练习渐进式肌肉放松或腹式呼吸技术，并通过结构化家庭作业巩固技能；全程强调正常化、非评判觉察与个体化调适。

name: CBT暴露后恶性循环认知解构
description: 在单次现实暴露结束后，引导来访者识别并命名由回避行为维持的‘焦虑-厌恶-回避’自我强化循环，用具体事件链说明其如何阻断自然习惯化过程。

name: CBT核心信念四句锚定小结
description: 在单次CBT咨询结束阶段，以精炼、非说教、生活化方式陈述四句核心认知行为原理，用于强化概念内化、支持作业执行，并为后续干预建立共同理解框架。

name: CBT核心信念巩固性重述
description: 在巩固阶段，引导来访者用第一人称、现在时、肯定句式重述已修正的核心信念，强调接纳局限性与生活平衡价值，强化新认知的稳定性与自我归属感。

name: CBT核心信念探索与能力再评估工作流程
description: 通过回顾个人经历、行为实验与能力盘点，引导来访者接触并松动关于自我、他人、世界的深层核心信念，重点重建自我效能感，适用于咨询中后期寻求根本性认同转变的情境。

name: CBT核心信念温习微作业布置
description: 在CBT单次咨询结束阶段，向求助者布置每日5分钟温习本次共同构建的1–3条合理核心信念的家庭作业，以强化神经可塑性、促进信念内化与行为迁移；严格限定形式（默读/朗读/录音复听）、时长（固定5分钟）、频次（每日一次）、起始时间（当日即始），不附加反思或实验任务。

name: CBT核心信念矫正工作流程
description: 通过识别自动思维→追溯中间信念→挖掘核心信念→检验证据→发展替代性核心信念的标准化序列，系统性更新来访者关于自我、他人、世界的核心信念。适用于已建立稳定咨询关系、能耐受认知探索的情绪困扰来访者。

name: CBT核心信念识别与协同重构
description: 在咨询初期、信任关系已初步建立的前提下，运用CBT认知概念化框架识别求助者不合理核心信念，并通过苏格拉底式提问、证据检验与协作生成等方式，引导其发展更具现实性、适应性与弹性的替代信念。

name: CBT深呼吸放松训练
description: 引导来访者通过有节奏的深呼吸练习实现生理与心理同步放松，用于缓解急性焦虑、改善睡眠启动障碍。适用于咨询中或日常自我调节场景。

name: CBT渐进式意象放松引导
description: 在首次咨询中向来访者教授标准化渐进性放松训练步骤，指导其每日3分钟自主练习，并明确反馈要求，以快速缓解焦虑、改善睡眠及增强自我调节感。

name: CBT焦虑-羞愧情绪链识别微干预
description: 在第3–4次CBT咨询中，基于个案具体生理/行为线索（如手心出汗、回避检查），引导其即时识别羞愧、内疚、自责等特定情绪，并锚定其背后的自动化思维与中间信念，构建‘情境→情绪→思维→信念’的可命名、可复述的觉察链条。

name: CBT焦虑干预四阶段流程
description: 一个结构化、分阶段的CBT个案干预框架，适用于学习受挫引发的青少年焦虑问题，含评估、认知重构、行为练习与巩固四个阶段。

name: CBT现实暴露中的实时情绪锚定与反馈
description: 在可控现实暴露过程中，咨询师每3～5分钟主动询问来访者当前主观焦虑强度（0–10分），同步引导其觉察情绪峰值时刻的自动思维变化，并在暴露结束后即时联结情绪消退体验与认知修正（如‘所担心的事并未发生’），以强化情绪-认知联结学习。

name: CBT现实暴露任务分级与实施计划
description: 在认知行为疗法框架下，为焦虑相关人际情境设计等级化暴露任务，并协同来访者制定包含去灾难化、回避行为教育、目标设定三要素的暴露实施计划。

name: CBT社交恐惧症暴露练习结构化方案
description: 在认知行为疗法框架下，为社交恐怖症求助者设计并实施渐进式暴露练习的结构化会话流程，含情绪监控、情景分级、作业布置与反思要求。

name: CBT社交焦虑阶段性咨询框架
description: 一个结构化、分阶段的CBT咨询流程，覆盖从建立联盟、认知重构到行为暴露与复发预防的全过程，专用于社交焦虑障碍的系统干预。

name: CBT终期会谈结构化框架
description: 在认知行为疗法（CBT）第10次（终期）咨询中，系统性完成认知成果巩固、疗效评估、现实迁移预演与分离情绪处理的标准化会谈流程。

name: CBT结束阶段三重巩固协议
description: 在最后一次CBT咨询中同步执行三项核心任务：引导来访者回顾自身变化与已掌握的有效技术、协助处理分离焦虑、共同构建现实可行的复发预防策略，形成结构化、内化导向的闭环收尾。

name: CBT结束阶段再教育与技能泛化工作流程
description: 在CBT咨询末期，结构化回顾咨询历程，强化新习得的认知与行为技能，指导求助者将所学迁移至日常生活场景，尤其聚焦人际交往中的情绪调节与沟通技巧应用。

name: CBT结构化单次咨询流程
description: 在每次认知行为治疗会谈中，按固定顺序执行六个环节：当前状况与心境检查、与上次会谈的联结、议程设置、家庭作业回顾、议程议题讨论与新作业布置、阶段总结；确保会谈聚焦、高效且具教学性。

name: CBT考前焦虑三阶段咨询框架
description: 一个面向大学生考前焦虑的结构化CBT咨询流程，分为建立关系、心理帮扶（认知重构）、巩固应用三个阶段，每阶段有明确任务与方法指向，提供跨会话的阶段性CBT干预主干。

name: CBT考试焦虑三阶段咨询框架
description: 一个结构化、阶段化的认知行为疗法咨询流程，覆盖诊断评估与关系建立、心理帮助（含认知重构与放松训练）、结束与巩固三个核心阶段，适用于考试焦虑个案。

name: CBT考试焦虑三阶段咨询流程
description: 一个结构化、阶段化的认知行为疗法咨询流程，专用于医学生考试焦虑干预，覆盖关系建立与评估、认知重建与技能训练、效果巩固与结束三个阶段，共5次会谈。

name: CBT自动思维反驳话术模板
description: 提供一组结构化、可复用的自我反驳语句，用于挑战‘我不行’类核心负性自动思维，适用于咨询中引导来访者进行认知重构练习。

name: CBT自动思维识别与反应训练
description: 引导来访者使用标准认知工具识别并回应自动思维，以觉察功能不良认知和逻辑歪曲，从而减轻情绪症状。

name: CBT自动思维识别与苏格拉底式提问引导
description: 在认知行为疗法框架下，引导来访者识别特定情境中的负性自动思维，并通过结构化苏格拉底式提问促使其评估思维的真实性与适应性。适用于来访者已建立基本咨询关系、能报告具体情境与情绪反应时。

name: CBT自动思维识别与调整四步法
description: 在CBT会话中期干预阶段，引导来访者系统识别并挑战功能不良自动思维的结构化技术：①证据检验；②生成替代解释；③评估可能性（最坏/最好/最可能）；④自我同情提问。聚焦思维可塑性与认知弹性培养，强调协作性检验与来访者主动生成。

name: CBT自动思维识别与调整四步法
description: 在CBT框架下，使用结构化提问序列引导来访者从情绪出发，逐层挖掘自动化思维、中间信念与核心信念，实现认知内容的外化与层级标注。

name: CBT苏格拉底提问_不合理信念强度评估
description: 使用0–100%百分比量化技术，评估来访者对已明确定义的自动思维（如‘我很失败’）的主观确信度，作为认知重构的客观锚点；聚焦强度而非真假，要求整数输出与简要依据，闭环执行。

name: CBT行为实验设计与实施
description: 协同来访者设计可检验的假设性行为实验，用真实结果挑战适应不良信念，降低回避行为并提升情境自信。

name: CBT行为日志家庭作业布置与结构化反馈
description: 在首次咨询中标准化施测PHQ-9和GAD-7量表，向来访者解释结果含义，并据此形成初步工作评估，为CBT方案选择提供实证依据。

name: CBT认知修正引导框架
description: 一个聚焦于早期教育与意义重构的CBT会话支架，用于帮助来访者理解症状成因、识别自动化思维，并发展替代性叙述，尤其适用于道德颓废、罪恶感与羞耻相关困扰。

name: CBT认知偏差识别与重构引导
description: 在咨询中期阶段，引导来访者识别失恋和家庭关系中的不合理信念，并通过共同分析促发其认知调整动机。适用于来访者已建立基本咨访关系、情绪初步稳定、能配合叙述具体场景时。

name: CBT认知家庭作业结构化指派
description: 在来访者已理解ABC模型并完成至少一轮认知质辩后，指导其在生活情境中实践结构化认知重构：记录事件→识别自动思维→标注认知扭曲→生成合理替代想法→应用自我暗示，形成闭环练习。

name: CBT认知扭曲识别与面质
description: 在认知调整阶段，使用面质技术帮助来访者识别并挑战其'全或无'、'非黑即白'等极端化自动思维。适用于来访者已表达自我贬低（如'觉得自己是活该的'）且存在明显认知偏差时。

name: CBT认知概念化建模
description: 基于来访者信念与行为模式构建个体化认知概念化图，作为后续干预的理论锚点和治疗地图；用于每次咨询初始阶段或概念化修订时。

name: CBT认知行为干预阶段工作框架
description: 在心理咨询第3～8次中，系统性开展自动思维识别、正念觉察训练与行为激活三类核心干预，通过结构化家庭作业与会谈反馈形成闭环。适用于已建立基本咨访关系、情绪稳定性初步达标、有意愿配合结构化练习的来访者。

name: CBT认知重构双路径技术
description: 结合提问引导与自我审查两种互补策略：前者通过多角度提问揭示思维盲区，后者通过表达-体验-反省闭环促进不合理信念觉察与修正，聚焦舞台失误归因偏差。

name: CBT认知重构双路径技术
description: 一种短程认知干预模块，包含‘提问引导’（多角度提问促觉察不合理思维）与‘自我审查’（鼓励表达并反省自我看法）两个平行子路径，用于矫正舞台表现相关的错误归因与灾难化信念。

name: CBT认知重构四步工作法
description: 在心理帮助阶段（第2～5次）系统性地识别、检验、修正和巩固来访者错误认知的结构化会话级干预流程。适用于存在明显表层与核心错误观念、且情绪行为受其主导的来访者。

name: CBT认知重构引导流程
description: 在咨询中期阶段，通过分析来访者自我报告和测评结果，系统引导其识别并纠正与专业调剂相关的错误认知，促使其形成客观理性的现实评估。

name: Cell-Cell Communication Analysis (CellChat)
description: ✅ **Use when:** - You have an annotated scRNA-seq dataset (Seurat object with cell type labels) - You want to identify ligand-receptor interactions between cell types - You want to visualize communication networks (chord diagrams, bubble plots) - You want to find dominant sender/receiver cell populations - **Chains from** `scrnaseq-seurat-core-analysis` output (`seurat_processed.rds`)

name: cell-cell-communication
description: Infer ligand-receptor signaling between cell types from scRNA-seq (and spatial) data. name: cell-cell-communication
description: Infer ligand-receptor signaling networks from annotated single-cell RNA-seq data and produce publication-ready communication plots. name: cell-cell-communication-benchmarking

name: cell-cell-communication-inference-from-scrnaseq
description: Use when scRNA-seq data has cluster/cell-type annotations and the goal is to compute transcriptome-based communication scores between sender and receiver clusters and rank specific ligand-receptor pairs (e.g., checkpoints, chemokines).

name: cell-cell-communication-matrix-factorization
description: Use when you have scRNA-seq expression (genes x cells) plus cell labels and need species-agnostic cell-cell communication inference, especially when no curated L-R database exists for the species or condition-specific shared vs unique signals are of interest.

name: cell-cell-communication-method-benchmarking
description: Use when single-cell RNA-Seq data must be interrogated for ligand-receptor interactions with multiple CCC methods, or when per-method interaction scores need to be combined into a robust consensus ranking via LIANA.

name: cell-cell-communication-module-interpretation
description: Use when you have pre-computed ligand-receptor CCI predictions (e.g., from CellChat on a scRNA-seq dataset such as GSE72056 melanoma) and need to biologically interpret which interaction groups/signals characterize a specific sender or receiver cell type.

name: cell-cell-communication-network-analysis
description: Use when you have clustered scRNA-seq cell groups and need to infer significant ligand-receptor communication between them, quantify pathway-level signaling, identify dominant senders/receivers, and group coordinated outgoing/incoming patterns.

name: cell-cell-communication-network-inference
description: Use when single-cell-resolution spatial transcriptomics data (e.g., seqFISH+ mouse cortex, Seq-Scope mouse colon) with a gene expression matrix plus cell spatial coordinates and cell-type labels is available, and the goal is to estimate which neighboring cell types regulate HVG expression.

name: cell-cell-communication-score-computation
description: Use when you need to quantify communication potential between an input cell population and partner cell types from transcriptomic data, e.g. comparing outward signaling of CAF-S1 vs CAF-S4 or LPS-stimulated DCs against the Primary Cell Atlas.

name: cell-cell-distance-based-communication-analysis

name: cell-cell-distance-inference-from-transport-plan

name: cell-cell-interaction-expression-profiling

name: cell-cell-interaction-label-aggregation

name: cell-cell-interaction-network-degree-analysis

name: cell-cell-interaction-network-inference

name: cell-cell-interaction-risk-score-modeling

name: cell-cell-signaling-perturbation-scoring

name: cell-citation

(year). Title. Journal vol, pages. DOI.' name: cell-clustering-ari-evaluation

name: cell-clustering-validation-with-marker-genes

name: cell-code-review

Use when asked to review, clean up, or improve code quality/naming/comments in one or more tutorials, or after writing new tutorial code that should be checked before it ships.

name: cell-communication-cellphonedb

name: cell-communication-gene-labeling

name: cell-communication-liana
description: Analyze cell-cell communication using LIANA+ to identify significant ligand-receptor interactions between cell types. (Recommended!)

name: cell-communication-network-extraction
description: Use when you have a CPM-normalized single-cell expression matrix plus a cell-annotation metafile and want to predict which ligand–receptor pairs mediate communication between annotated cell types.

name: cell-communication-statistics-summary
description: Use when a single-cell atlas (e.g. Tabula Muris, ~117 cell types) has been processed with NATMI and you need organism-wide summary metrics of autocrine signalling, such as the median number of co-detected ligand–receptor pairs per cell type.

name: cell-composition

Use when user wants to know what cell types exist, their proportions, or where specific cells are located. Triggers: "cell type composition", "deconvolution", "what cells are here", "cell type proportions", "estimate cell types", "annotate cells", "which cell types".

name: cell-composition-differential-testing-along-pseudotime
description: Decision support for detecting condition- or covariate-associated changes in cell abundance/density along a multi-sample scRNA-seq pseudotime trajectory (Lamian TCD/XCD testing).

name: cell-connectivity-estimation-from-single-cell-data
description: Use when you have a set of minimum spanning trees (one per Totem/CLARA clustering, constructed with Slingshot) and need per-cell connectivity values in [0,1] to rank clusterings and identify likely trajectory leaves and branch points.

name: cell-connectivity-profiling
description: Use when the input is a single-cell expression dataset (SingleCellExperiment) expected to follow a linear, bifurcating, or multifurcating tree trajectory, and you need to rank candidate clusterings and locate trajectory leaves and branch points without a prior clustering.

name: cell-connectivity-summary-edge-aggregation
description: Use when NATMI ExtractEdges.py output edges exist and the goal is to summarise the entire communication network to show how strongly or specifically each cell type communicates to every other cell type, identifying highly communicating cell-type pairs or communities.

name: cell-connectivity-vector-analysis
description: Use when a Totem analysis has produced many candidate CLARA clusterings and you must automatically pick which one(s) to feed into Slingshot MST construction based on cell connectivity.

name: cell-contract
description: Del mockup aprobado (o del ticket, si es solo backend) al PR de contrato (solo líder técnico), ANTES de lanzar workers. Deriva campos, errores, enums, filtros y orden; actualiza contracts/openapi.json, mocks MSW y mensajes de error. Usar cuando el diseño esté aprobado o el ticket sea tipo A, o "cell-contract", "armá el contrato".

name: cell-count-scaling-benchmark-analysis
description: Use when you must show how reconstruction accuracy and sensitivity of a scGRN method depend on the number of input cells, and ground-truth regulatory edges (e.g., SERGIO-simulated 100-gene modules) are available for scoring.

name: cell-count-subsampling-scalability-analysis
description: Use when you must quantify the runtime, memory, and clustering-performance scaling of an integration/clustering method across increasing numbers of cells and compare it with alternatives.

name: cell-count-summary-reporting
description: Use when a VDJ preprocessing or filtering step (e.g. setupVdjPseudobulk) has just been applied and you must quantify and report how many cells were retained versus input, as a baseline check before downstream pseudobulking or trajectory analysis.

name: cell-coverage-outlier-filtering
description: Use when a raw single-cell ChIP-seq/scATAC-seq count matrix (cells x bins/peaks/TSS regions) contains low-quality or extreme-coverage cells that must be filtered before PCA, t-SNE/UMAP, or clustering.

name: cell-crowding-visualization
description: Use when evaluating whether a low-dimensional embedding of small UMI count matrices suffers from cell crowding at the latent origin, comparing vMF spherical vs Euclidean VAE latents or t-SNE/UMAP/PHATE baselines.

name: cell-culture-basics
description: Mammalian cell culture fundamentals — aseptic technique, passaging, cryopreservation, and contamination control.

name: cell-culture-best-practices
description: Use when applying cell culture best practices.

name: cell-culture-fundamentals
description: Use when applying cell culture fundamentals.

name: cell-culture-implementation
description: Use when applying cell culture implementation.

name: cell-culture-tech

Specializes in HEK293, HeLa, CHO, and primary cells. Use when: cell-culture, aseptic-technique, cell-passaging, tissue-culture, mycoplasma-testing.

name: cell-culture-troubleshooting
description: Use when applying cell culture troubleshooting.

name: cell-curator
description: Annotate pre-clustered AnnData or MuData from local marker, ontology, reference, and multimodal evidence. Use for review-gated cell-type annotation, uncertainty assessment, parent-scoped refinement, and guarded write-back.

name: cell-cycle-age-distribution-modeling
description: Use when flow-cytometric single-cell data from an unsynchronized, exponentially growing culture must be placed on real cell-cycle time, and no time-resolved sampling exists to calibrate pseudotime directly.

name: cell-cycle-analysis
description: Cell cycle phase scoring and visualization for single-cell expression data. Uses Scanpy's score_genes_cell_cycle with Tirosh et al. 2015 S/G2M gene lists on any normalized AnnData (ThreePrimeUntargeted via Loader, scRNA-seq-like, or AnnData from CSV/parquet count matrix). Regressing out cell cycle effects for downstream analysis. Use when the user asks about cell cycle, proliferation, S phase, G2M, or cell state.

name: cell-cycle-effect-removal
description: Decision support for removing cell-cycle effects from single-cell RNA-seq expression matrices when an annotated set of cell-cycle control genes is available and downstream analyses require corrected expression.

name: cell-cycle-effect-removal
description: Use when a scRNA-Seq expression matrix (log-scaled, gene-by-gene centered) shows within-cell-type heterogeneity driven by annotated cell-cycle genes that obscures clustering of cell types or substructure, and a known cell-cycle gene set can be retrieved.

name: cell-cycle-effect-removal-method-benchmarking
description: Use when scRNA-seq data contain cell-cycle effects confounding subclone or subpopulation delineation, and the goal is to quantify which correction approach (circular vs linear) maximizes subclone separability.

name: cell-cycle-gene-annotation-mapping
description: Use when preparing a gene-by-cell expression matrix for ccRemover: gene names must be mapped to human ('human') or mouse ('mouse') cell-cycle annotations to build the if_cc indicator vector before running ccRemover.

name: cell-cycle-gene-list-curation
description: Use when preparing DeepCycle inputs: you need an organism-specific cell-cycle gene list, a base cycling gene (Nusap1 for mESCs, MELK for human fibroblasts), and expression/filter thresholds for gene inclusion.

name: cell-cycle-gene-phase-annotation
description: Use when single cells have been reordered along a differentiation trajectory (pseudo-temporal position) and you must cluster gene expression dynamics into temporal waves and check whether cell-cycle gene sets (mitosis vs DNA synthesis) fall into distinct, out-of-phase clusters.

name: cell-cycle-gene-regression-preprocessing
description: Use when applying UniTVelo to a pancreas AnnData with spliced/unspliced counts where a known subtle fate transition (e.g., Fev+ to Delta) must be recovered both with and without cell-cycle gene regression, to match a reference fate-mapping result.

name: cell-cycle-gene-set-factor-analysis
description: Use when labeled (Hoechst or equivalent) scRNA-seq or qPCR single-cell data are available and the goal is to quantify how accurately different cell-cycle characterization methods recover cell-cycle phase labels.

name: cell-cycle-geneset-enrichment-interpretation
description: Use when you need to show that periodic genes discovered ab initio from a circular manifold (Cyclum pseudo-time) are more enriched for GO:0007049 cell-cycle terms than genes ranked by principal components on scRNA-seq data.

name: cell-cycle-marker-expression-analysis
description: Use when a velocity-informed circular trajectory (e.g., Cytopath on the U2OS SMART-Seq2 cell cycle dataset) has been inferred and G1-phase cells must be split into early vs late stages and validated with marker expression tests.

name: cell-cycle-nicotine-target-nomination
description: Use when comparing a treated vs. control single-cell RNA-seq dataset (e.g., 10X Chromium hESC, ~12,280 cells) to find genes whose periodic/circular expression kinetics change between conditions.

name: cell-cycle-phase-binning
description: Use when h5ad data carry a continuous DeepCycle phase annotation (adata.obs['cell_cycle_theta']) with Ms/Mu layers, and you need to quantify how per-cell RNA content (total UMIs) changes around the cell cycle or locate phase transitions.

name: cell-cycle-phase-classification
description: Use when a processed Seurat object or count matrix from single-cell/spatial RNA-seq needs per-cell cell cycle phase assignment (G0, G1, S, G2M), e.g. to quantify quiescent fractions alongside accordion() cell type annotation.

name: cell-cycle-phase-classification-svm
description: Use when you have single-cell imaging (4i) or single-cell RNA-seq data with a top-k ranked feature subset and ground-truth cell cycle phase labels, and need an accuracy-based comparison of feature selection methods.

name: cell-cycle-phase-correlation-analysis
description: Use when scRNA-seq data exhibit dominant cell cycling at the onset of differentiation and you need to check whether RNA velocity-based simulation trajectories recapitulate cell cycle stages.

name: cell-cycle-phase-inference-deep-learning
description: Use when scRNA-seq data contains spliced/unspliced layers, cells are proliferating, and a continuous cell cycle phase assignment is needed from RNA velocity dynamics rather than gene-marker scoring.

name: cell-cycle-phase-scoring-tricycle
description: Use when you need to evaluate whether forecast or observed single-cell transcriptomic states recapitulate cell-cycle progression, by mapping cells (genes x cells matrices, e.g. scEU-seq hTERT RPE data) to tricycle phase positions.

name: cell-cycle-phase-transition-estimation
description: Use when an h5ad annotated by DeepCycle (with obs['cell_cycle_theta'] and scVelo Ms/Mu layers) needs cell-cycle phase labels and per-phase cell fractions, e.g. to validate inferred thetas against flow-cytometry proportions.

name: cell-cycle-pseudo-time-inference
description: Use when scRNA-seq gene expression is expected to follow a periodic process (e.g., cell cycle) and you need ab initio per-cell pseudo-time or phase ordering without prior marker-gene lists.

name: cell-cycle-pseudo-time-reconstruction
description: Use when given an unsynchronized scRNA-seq expression matrix (log2 TPM+1) and the goal is to recover cell cycle ordering (G1, S, G2/M) or compare pseudo-time methods such as SCUBA, Monocle, TSCAN, Wishbone, or DPT.

name: cell-cycle-pseudotime-evaluation
description: Use when evaluating an ordering/pseudo-time method for cyclic single-cell data against known stage labels (e.g., G1/S/G2/M), by sweeping cluster number k and comparing correlation-score curves between a proposed method and baselines.

name: cell-cycle-score-clustering
description: Use when a single-cell RNA-seq dataset may contain quiescent G0-like cells that confound pseudotime reconstruction, and cell-cycle scores (e.g. reCAT mean scores) are available to identify and remove them.

name: cell-cycle-scoring-single-cell
description: Use when a projected single-cell query contains predicted cycling cells (e.g. Mki67+ exhausted T cells) that need to be quantified and visualized against the projected cell-state labels.

name: cell-cycle-stage-comparison
description: Use when you have single-cell Hi-C contact matrices resolved by cell-cycle stage and need to test whether nested TLD hierarchy (modularity, TLD-adjR2, weighted similarity WS) changes across stages such as G1 vs S phase vs G2.

name: cell-cycle-stage-interpretation-of-marker-genes
description: Use when you need to demonstrate or verify that individual cell cycle marker genes cannot classify single cells into cycle stages, motivating a multi-gene, genome-wide approach such as reCAT.

name: cell-cycle-variation-removal
description: Use when single-cell count matrices show cell-cycle-driven confounding (per-cell cell-cycle scores/phases available) that must be removed while preserving biological signal such as subclone or cell-type separability.

name: cell-data
description: Use to build Cell's data and code deposition plan and the Data and Code Availability statement that lives inside STAR Methods Resource Availability — approved repositories, accessions/DOIs at submission, and Cell's three-bullet availability format with Mendeley Data as Elsevier's default.

name: cell-data
description: Draft or audit the data, code, materials and supplemental side of a Cell manuscript: the Resource availability section (Lead contact, Materials availability, Data and code availability), the key resources table with RRIDs, a deposition plan for sequencing, imaging and code, and the supplemental files (Document S1, naming, sizes, Excel tables). Not for data cleaning or statistical analysis.

name: cell-data-figure
description: 科研数据绘图、顶刊数据图复现与研究数据替换。先按研究问题和数据结构选择可比参考图， 必须用数据编写并实际运行参考复现代码，核验视觉一致性后才能替换用户数据。 最终只交付最终版绘图代码、绘图前数据和 TIF/JPG/PDF 图件。 当用户要求以参考论文图为复现对象、复刻其数据图风格并在门槛通过后替换研究数据时使用； 一般 Python/MATLAB 绘图代码生成、重构或代码规范审核使用 cell-visualization-code。 不用于机制示意图、图形摘要、照片编辑或图片描摹矢量化。

name: cell-density-convex-hull-coverage-quantification
description: Use when evaluating scRNA-seq embeddings for trajectory inference suitability and you need a quantitative cell-density metric: cells should be well-distributed (neither over-clumped nor over-dispersed) in the 2D embedding before fitting pseudotime.

name: cell-design
description: Use when generating a design OR when ANY change alters the architecture — a component added, removed, or renamed; an edge or dependency changed; exposure changed; an external/SaaS dependency added or dropped. specs/design/design.cell moves FIRST, before the rest of the design (domain-model.md, flows/, the component design.json files). Covers the grammar, the AEP boundary semantics (where each dependency goes), and the write protocol that drives the live architecture diagram.

name: cell-design
description: Del ticket al mockup aprobado (solo líder técnico). Fase de diseño de los tickets tipo B (cambia una pantalla) y C (pantalla nueva): mockup con componentes reales, ux-advisor, Artifact y OK de Gabriel. Usar cuando el plan marque tipo B o C, o "cell-design", "armá el mockup".

name: cell-detection

name: cell-detection
description: Comprehensive guide to cell detection. Master the concepts, implementation, best practices, and real-world applications of cell detection in professional environments.

name: cell-diagram

name: cell-dimension-value-extraction
description: Use when processing natural-language prokaryotic taxonomic descriptions to populate a taxon-by-character matrix with cell dimension (diameter, width, length) measurement states and units.

name: cell-divide

INERT in Phase 1 — do not execute recursive division yet.

name: cell-dynamics
description: Understand cellular differentiation, state transitions, and dynamic processes through trajectory and velocity analysis. Use when user wants to study development, differentiation, cell fate decisions, or temporal dynamics. Triggers: "trajectory", "pseudotime", "RNA velocity", "differentiation", "cell fate", "how do cells develop", "lineage", "dynamics", "scVelo", "CellRank".

name: cell-embedding-reliability-classification
description: Use when a Seurat scRNA-seq/CyTOF object has been embedded with t-SNE or UMAP and you need to quantify which cell embeddings are dubious vs trustworthy, or to pick hyperparameters (perplexity, min.dist, n.neighbors) by minimizing dubious embeddings.

name: cell-explore

name: cell-fate-dynamical-analysis
description: Use when a validated biomolecular network model must be simulated via dynamical analysis to obtain cell fate outcomes (normal proliferation, apoptosis), or when its robustness to small input perturbations must be quantified by SEM.

name: cell-fate-dynamical-manifold-construction

name: cell-fate-fraction-quantification
description: Use when you have simulated single-cell trajectories from a PRESCIENT perturbation run (e.g., TF overexpression/knockdown sweeps) and need to measure how perturbation magnitude shifts fate fractions at the terminal time point, with statistical testing of reciprocal fate changes.

name: cell-fate-lineage-classification
description: Use when you have GEMLI-predicted lineage assignments plus cell type annotations (e.g., DCIS vs inv_tumor cells from GSE148093 breast cancer biopsies) and need to separate symmetric from asymmetric (mixed-fate) lineages and profile DEGs per fate class.

name: cell-fate-probability-inference
description: Use when a scRNA-seq task asks to transfer continuous (non-discrete) annotations such as 7-dimensional cell fate probability vectors between two sequencing runs of the Tusi hematopoietic progenitor dataset, and to rank annotation-transfer methods by JSD.

name: cell-fate-probability-normalization
description: Use when RNA velocity (scvelo spliced/unspliced AnnData) plus Cytopath consensus trajectory steps are available and you need per-cell alignment scores, trajectory assignments, pseudotime, fate probabilities, or differentiation potential per cell.

name: cell-fate-probability-quantification
description: Use when scRNA-seq data with cluster annotations and an RNA velocity field are available and you need per-cell probabilities of reaching defined terminal fates (e.g., alpha, beta, epsilon) plus aggregate end-fate frequencies from stochastic Markov sampling.

name: cell-fate-probability-validation-pancreatic-endocrine
description: Use when simulating cell-fate decisions from a preprocessed pancreatic endocrine AnnData with cluster annotations and differentiation potentials, and RNA velocity is unreliable, so trajectories must be biased by the differentiation-potential gradient toward terminal fates.

name: cell-fate-propensity-quantification
description: Use when a validated biomolecular regulatory network (e.g., the 197-node/744-edge Cho et al. network) has been simulated with CanSeer's DA and stable-state probabilities must be converted into per-fate propensity values for validation or treatment comparison.

name: cell-fate-terminal-state-detection-evaluation
description: Use when a single-cell trajectory dataset may harbor elusive or low-population terminal fates (e.g., multifurcating, cyclic, or disconnected topologies) and you need automated terminal-state calling plus a quantitative fate-recovery score against known labels.

name: cell-fate-transition-scoring
description: Use when evaluating RNA velocity or latent-trajectory outputs on a multi-lineage, multi-batch scRNA-seq dataset (e.g., mouse gastrulation AnnData with spliced/unspliced layers) and you need quantitative transition, batch-mixing, and velocity-consistency scores.

name: cell-favorability-score-computation
description: Use when a significant directed cell-cell interaction network (e.g., cytotoxic cells → tumor cells) has already been inferred from bulk expression plus survival data with TimiGP and you need per-cell favorable/unfavorable prognostic rankings.

Sizes, fonts, lines, colour and file rules are Cell's own (85 / 114 / 174 mm, Arial, about 6-8 pt, capital panel letters, TIFF or PDF). Not for interactive dashboards or statistics-only analysis.

name: cell-figure-guide
description: Cell (Cell Press) figure preparation: resolution (300-1000 DPI), formats (TIFF/PDF), RGB color, Avenir/Arial fonts, uppercase panel labels, strict image manipulation policies.

name: cell-figure-guide

name: cell-figures

name: cell-fit

name: cell-free-protein-expression
description: Cell-free protein synthesis (CFPS) planning and optimization guidance. Use when: (1) Planning CFPS experiments, (2) Troubleshooting low yield or aggregation, (3) Optimizing DNA template design for CFPS, (4) Expressing difficult proteins (disulfide-rich, toxic, membrane).

name: cell-gene-matrix-extraction-from-segmentation-mask
description: Use when a BIDCell segmentation mask (pixel values = cell IDs, *_connected.tif) must be converted into a per-cell transcript count matrix (expr_mat.csv) from a transcripts file such as Xenium's transcripts.csv.gz.

name: cell-graph-topology-reconstruction
description: Use when a scRNA-seq count matrix must be embedded in a latent space that preserves inter-cell topological/trajectory structure, not just per-cell features — e.g. clustering and trajectory inference where inter-cluster distances matter.

name: cell-grna-assignment-annotation
description: Use when a single-cell CRISPR screen needs gRNAs assigned to cell barcodes from per-cell UMI counts, especially to separate ambient from endogenously expressed guides and distinguish singlets from multiplets.

name: cell-hashing-data-analysis
description: Use when validating a cell-calling method (e.g., EmptyNN) on a cell hashing dataset by asking whether retained barcodes are transcriptionally closer to confirmed cells than removed barcodes within the same cell type.

name: cell-hashing-demultiplexing
description: Use when a Seurat object carries an 'HTO' assay from a cell-hashing experiment and per-cell sample identities (singlet/doublet/negative) must be called, especially with many hashtags, imbalanced sample sizes, or degraded hashtag staining.

name: cell-hashing-snp-label-correlation
description: Use when a dataset has both cell hashing (HTO) demultiplexing labels and SNP/genotype-based demultiplexing labels (e.g. scSplit) and per-cell sample identities must be reconciled into a final assignment.

Audits a cell implementation against its health contract and produces a structured report with remediation suggestions.

name: cell-host-and-microbe

name: cell-similarity-network-construction
description: Use when you have multiple low-dimensional latent representation matrices of single cells (e.g. from a stacked variational autoencoder with latent dimension d = 15) and need to determine cell groups and cluster assignments.

name: cell-source-isolation

name: cell-spanning

name: cell-specific-network-construction
description: Use when a normalized scRNA-seq gene expression matrix (m genes × n cells) needs to be transformed into direct gene–gene association networks per cell, or into a CNDM for downstream clustering/dimension reduction.

name: cell-specific-regulatory-network-inference
description: Use when evaluating or comparing cell-specific network inference algorithms on single-cell expression data where per-cell ground-truth regulatory networks (or a simulator such as dyngen that provides them) are available for AUROC/AUPR scoring.

name: cell-star-methods
description: Use to build Cell's mandatory STAR Methods — the Key Resources Table, the three Resource Availability subsections, Experimental Model and Subject Details, Method Details, and Quantification and Statistical Analysis, in the exact required order.

name: cell-state-annotation-nearest-neighbor
description: Use when query scRNA-seq count matrices (e.g. 10x/hdf5 CD45+ TIL or P14 T cell data) must be assigned reference cell-state labels and subtype frequencies by projecting them onto a curated TIL or viral-infection reference atlas.

name: cell-state-composition-frequency-analysis
description: Use when projecting scRNA-seq query data (e.g., Regnase-1-null vs WT CD8+ TILs) onto a reference atlas and you need cell-state frequency compositions per condition to detect enrichment of subtypes like Tpex or Tex.

name: cell-state-gene-signature-overlap-analysis
description: Use when validating a learned cell-state classifier (e.g., Pollock explain-mode DWGs) against curated marker databases like PanglaoDB, or when asked which cell states' feature scores recover known markers.

name: cell-state-transition-network-modeling
description: Use when analyzing TSCS single-cell RT-PCR or RNA-seq data from two consecutive stages of a cell-state transition (e.g., ICM->EPI, ICM->PE) and needing a directed, weighted, sparse GRN without constructing pseudo-time.

name: cell-statistics
description: Audit or draft the statistical reporting of a Cell manuscript: replicate unit, biological vs technical replicates, tests, multiple testing, figure-legend statistics, and the STAR Methods section 'Quantification and statistical analysis'. Use for legend statistics checks, pseudoreplication in single-cell or spatial data, and reviewer concerns about statistics. Computes new analyses only when the user supplies data and asks.

name: cell-stem-cell

name: cell-submission
description: Use as the final preflight before submitting to Cell — a complete checklist across significance, narrative, Highlights/eTOC/Graphical Abstract, Summary, figures, STAR Methods, data, references, and required files. Bundles the checklist and cover-letter templates.

name: cell-subpopulation-identification-in-2d-embedding
description: Use when scRNA-seq data contain known or suspected heterogeneous cell populations (e.g., developmental stages E3–E7 or lineage compartments like ICM/PE/EPI vs TE) that should be recovered as separable clusters in a low-dimensional 2D visualization.

name: cell-subsampling-and-label-shuffling
description: Use when you need to test how sensitive CCC inference methods (CellChat, CellPhoneDB, Connectome, NATMI, SingleCellSignalR, iTALK, Cytotalk via LIANA) are to cell-level noise—reduced cell numbers or erroneous cell-type annotation—in a scRNA-seq dataset.

name: cell-subset-filtering-by-reference-annotation
description: Use when a heterogeneous PBMC scRNA-seq object has coarse reference-based (SingleR) lineage labels — e.g. a T/NK subset — and the goal is to recluster that subset to expose rare subtypes or doublets hidden by the annotation.

name: cell-subset-resampling-across-patients
description: Use when you need to characterize computational scaling (wall-clock time, peak memory) of MaCroDNA, clonealign, or Seurat on patient-stratified scDNA/scRNA data by re-running at controlled sampling rates such as 0.5–1.0.

name: cell-subtype-fine-annotation-with-template-classifiers
description: Use when a normalized single-cell tumor scRNA-seq expression matrix needs cell subtype labels beyond the five major TME types, using pretrained subtype templates rather than reference-free clustering.

name: cell-subtype-similarity-map-construction
description: Use when fine cell subtype annotations from different published references must be related quantitatively, or when subtypes from a reference (e.g., the PBMC multimodal reference) must be transferred onto tumor-derived cells and compared across datasets.

name: cell-subtype-supervised-classification

name: cell-summary
description: Use to write Cell's Summary — a single unstructured paragraph of ≤ ~150 words that conveys the complete story, the mechanism, and the broad significance, quantified and readable by a general life-scientist. Late-stage polish.

name: cell-to-clone-assignment
description: Use when you have matched scDNA-seq copy-number data, scRNA-seq gene-expression data, and a clone-label table mapping each DNA cell to a clone id, and you need to predict which clone each RNA cell belongs to.

name: cell-to-landmark-pair-assignment
description: Use when a landmark-labeled low-dimensional expression matrix is available and you must quantify neighborhood-based cell state transitions between landmark pairs to build a weighted transition graph.

name: cell-to-niche-group-assignment
description: Use when a segmented SpatialData object (e.g. MERSCOPE liver cells with cell-type or niche labels) must be grouped into spatially contiguous niches and characterized geometrically.

name: cell-to-region-assignment
description: Use when single-cell coordinates with marker intensities (e.g. MCMICRO-processed CyCIF data in an AnnData object) must be annotated with region labels derived from marker-defined cell populations like SOX10+ tumor cells.

name: cell-to-trajectory-assignment-entropy-scoring
description: Use when benchmarking trajectory inference methods on a branching (bifurcating) dataset with close, fine lineages, where purity of cell-to-trajectory assignments and per-path pseudotime accuracy must be quantified.

name: cell-tracking-starter

name: cell-transition-metabolite-association
description: Use when you have longitudinal/high-dimensional metabolomics data (e.g., 1H-NMR concentration tables) spanning sequential cell states and need to extract transition-specific metabolite subnetworks rather than global correlations.

name: cell-type-abundance-comparison-across-culture-media
description: Use when bulk RNA-seq samples were grown under different differentiation media (e.g. UNC vs SC air-liquid interface cultures) and you need to verify or estimate cell type composition shifts, such as ciliated vs secretory cell abundance, from gene signatures rather than deconvolution tools.

name: cell-type-abundance-thresholding
description: Use when building a supervised cell-type annotation model from a reference scRNA-seq matrix whose cell-type counts are imbalanced, and minority types risk being ignored during training.

name: cell-type-aggregate-score-verification
description: Use when per-cell pluripotency/differentiation scores from multiple methods (ORIGINS, LandSCENT, CytoTRACE) must be averaged within annotated cell types and their orderings compared for consistency, e.g. on the breast epithelial sample.

name: cell-type-aggregation-of-per-cell-scores
description: Use when per-cell stemness scores (ORIGINS activity, LandSCENT SR, CytoTRACE) have been computed on annotated scRNA-seq data and you need per-type averages and rankings to benchmark which method correctly identifies stem cells.

name: cell-type-agnostic-feature-computation
description: Use when candidate enhancer-gene pairs (e.g. cCRE-ELS within 500 KB of target gene TSSs) have been formed with createPairs and the CENTRE workflow requires the non-cell-type-specific feature columns before calling centrePrediction.

name: cell-type-annotated-reference-construction
description: Use when a large cell-type-annotated scRNA-seq reference (.h5ad) must be reduced to a representative sketch to serve as the reference matrix for deconvolution of pseudobulk/bulk RNA-seq samples, and sketch quality must be judged by proportion-estimate accuracy.

name: cell-type-annotation
description: scRNA-seq cell type annotation - read before any annotation skills. Chooses and runs the route: name clusters manually from canonical markers (scanpy, runnable code here), transfer labels with CellTypist or a popV/scANVI on a reference, or do both and validate one against other. Covers package availability, tissue- and state-matched references, marker panels, confidence and marker validation of transferred labels, doublets, unresolved clusters. Tool-specific code lives in celltypist/popv-cell-annotation and scvi-tools-single-cell.

name: cell-type-annotation
description: Generate code to assign cell type labels to single-cell RNA-seq clusters using CellTypist, SingleR, marker-based annotation, or reference label transfer (scANVI/ingest). Triggers on requests to "annotate cell types", "label clusters", "run CellTypist", "SingleR annotation", "marker gene dotplot", "transfer labels from reference atlas", "cell identity", "automated annotation", "reference mapping", "scANVI label transfer", "canonical markers", "immune cell types", "hierarchical annotation", "majority voting CellTypist", "over-clustering annotation".

description: Evidence-driven cell-type annotation of pre-clustered single-cell or spatial transcriptomics data (AnnData). Use whenever the user wants to annotate, label or identify the cell types or states of Leiden/Louvain clusters, build or refine a cell-type hierarchy, or interpret scRNA-seq / snRNA-seq / MERSCOPE / Xenium / Visium / CosMx clusters, even if they just say "what are these clusters?" or "label these cells". name: cell-type-annotation-accuracy-comparison
description: Use when a labeled reference scRNA-seq dataset (e.g., GEO/E-MTAB pancreas, PBMC) must be used to annotate one or more independent testing studies and per-method annotation accuracy needs to be quantified across all train-test combinations.

name: cell-type-annotation-accuracy-evaluation
description: Use when a trained cell-type annotation model (e.g. a DNN on .h5ad scRNA-seq data) must be scored against ground-truth labels on a held-out test set, or when comparing annotation tools for accuracy and run feasibility on large datasets (>0.6M cells).

name: cell-type-annotation-accuracy-validation
description: Use when GeneVector phenotype_probability annotations must be trusted before downstream analyses like latent-space arithmetic; trigger when an independent label source (e.g., CellAssign) exists for concordance checking.

name: cell-type-annotation-benchmarking

name: cell-type-annotation-by-gsea
description: Use when you have Seurat cluster marker lists (only.pos=TRUE, min.pct=0.25, logfc.threshold=0.25) from scRNA-seq data and need automated, database-backed cell-type annotation for each cluster.

name: cell-type-annotation-from-marker-genes
description: Use when scRNA-seq cluster assignments produced by an unsupervised method (e.g. scBGEDA) lack cell-type labels and a curated marker database such as CellMark can be matched against per-cluster DEGs.

name: cell-type-annotation-from-signature-scores
description: Use when a normalized scRNA-seq object (e.g., SingCellaR Human_HSPC) needs cell-type labels from lineage signature gene sets rather than marker-gene inspection or reference mapping.

name: cell-type-annotation-mapping
description: Use when you have a rooted lineage tree in Newick plus per-cell cell-type labels and want to quantify which cell types co-occur within subtrees (e.g., after cutting the LinRace embryo tree at depth 26).

name: cell-type-annotation-mapping
description: Use when a single-cell expression matrix (genes x cells) must be paired with a cell-annotation metafile before running NATMI ExtractEdges.py, or when cell-type labels need to be validated so edges are attributed to the right cell types.

name: cell-type-annotation-marker-genes
description: Use when you have a cell-by-factor or low-dimensional embedding from paired multi-omics data (e.g., Mowgli on TEA-seq PBMC) and need per-cell type labels grounded in canonical gene/protein markers plus an independent reference annotation.

name: cell-type-annotation-model-evaluation
description: Use when benchmarking a cell type annotation tool's accuracy on reference-to-query label transfer, or when assessing whether annotation performance depends on expert-knowledge masks vs. parameter-matched random masks.

name: cell-type-annotation-model-training
description: Use when confident cell type labels from a consensus of annotation tools must be spread to unlabeled cells in scRNA-seq data via a graph convolutional network, or when tuning GCN hyperparameters per dataset.

name: cell-type-annotation-model-training
description: Use when benchmarking how subsampling/sketching (e.g. scValue sketches at 0.02–0.10 fractions) affects supervised cell-type annotation accuracy on .h5ad scRNA-seq datasets with known ground-truth labels.

name: cell-type-annotation-pipeline-comparison-benchmarking
description: Use when you must quantify resource/accuracy trade-offs of cell type annotation pipelines on identical feature subsets of an scRNA-seq dataset (e.g., reproducing a Table-3-style comparison of accuracy, memory, and execution time).

name: cell-type-annotation-plotting
description: Use when comparing imputed vs. unimputed scRNA-seq matrices (e.g., Jurkat-293T or Zeisel datasets) to assess whether imputation improves clustering of annotated cell-type subpopulations, as in Fig. 5 of the AutoImpute paper.

name: cell-type-annotation-scoring-against-reference-database
description: Use when scRNA-seq clusters (e.g., from Seurat) need automatic, knowledge-free cell type annotation by scoring cluster marker genes against a tissue-specific cell taxonomy reference database rather than manual marker inspection.

name: cell-type-annotation-standardization
description: Use when combining scRNA-seq studies whose free-text cell annotations differ, e.g. before rendering a cross-study comparison of expression across aligned cell types in Cellenium (H5AD-imported studies with ontologized metadata).

name: cell-type-annotation-transfer-with-mlp-classifier
description: Use when semi-profiled single-cell data (e.g. scSemiProfiler output for a COVID-19 cohort with Healthy/Asymptomatic/Mild/Moderate/Severe/Critical conditions) is unlabeled, and annotated representative single-cell reference data exists to train a classifier for label transfer.

name: cell-type-annotation-visualization
description: Reference for annotating scywalker long-read single-nuclei per-cell gene counts with cell types from a markerset and visualizing the assignments on UMAP in the QC report.

name: cell-type-balanced-subset-allocation
description: Use when a large scRNA-seq AnnData (e.g. a 428k-cell gut atlas in .h5ad) must be subsampled to a fixed sketch size while preserving cell-type diversity and rare populations for downstream annotation/ML tasks.

name: cell-type-biomarker-ranking-extraction
description: Use when a trained scRNA-seq cell-type classifier (e.g. scaLR DNN on anndata .h5ad data) must be converted into per-class ranked gene lists, or when top-100 biomarkers must be checked for recall against a curated reference like CellMarker2.0.

name: cell-type-bootstrap-association-testing
description: Use when GWAS summary statistics and an annotated single-cell Seurat object are available and the goal is to rank predefined cell types for trait/disease association at FDR < 0.05 (e.g., AD vs. OPCs/microglia, severe COVID-19 vs. PBMC subsets).

name: cell-type-classification-accuracy-assessment
description: Use when scRNA-seq clusters have been produced and reference cell-type labels exist, and you need ARI plus per-cell-type classification accuracy (e.g., alpha/beta cells) to quantify clustering fidelity.

name: cell-type-classification-accuracy-computation
description: Use when benchmarking supervised cell-type classifiers on annotated scRNA-seq data and you need repeatable accuracy and balanced-accuracy estimates for SciBet, scmap, and Seurat v3 across many datasets.

name: cell-type-classification-evaluation
description: Use when a labeled single-cell RNA-seq AnnData (cell x gene, 'class_label' column) needs automated cell-type label transfer with measurable accuracy/F1, including imbalanced, many-class (e.g., 42-type mouse brain) or small-training-set settings.

name: cell-type-classification-evaluation
description: Use when you have a set of k selected marker genes on a labeled scRNA-seq AnnData object and need to quantify how well those markers discriminate cell types via classifier performance.

name: cell-type-classification-macro-f1-evaluation
description: Use when comparing cell type annotation models on a held-out test set and you need donor-generalizing performance metrics such as macro F1-score and cross-entropy loss.

name: cell-type-classification-performance-evaluation
description: Use when you have trained cell-type CRE classifiers (e.g., BOM/XGBoost on motif counts) and need to quantify prediction accuracy, such as fraction of elements assigned to the correct cell type or cross-species transfer rates.

name: cell-type-classification-runtime-benchmarking
description: Use when comparing or benchmarking the running time of automatic scRNA-seq cell-type identification methods on subsets of varying training/testing sizes, e.g. reproducing the Fig. 4 speed ranking on the mouse brain dataset GSE116470.

name: cell-type-clustering-ari-benchmarking
description: Use when reproducing the LUAD/HCC827-H1975-H2228 scRNA-seq clustering benchmark across three platforms with the 2267 common HVGs, or when comparing ARI of unsupervised batch-correction clustering to published values.

name: cell-type-clustering-assessment
description: Use when an scRNA-Seq matrix has been corrected for the cell-cycle effect and you must verify that cell-type signal was retained while cell-cycle heterogeneity was removed, comparing original vs corrected matrices.

name: cell-type-clustering-unknown-subtypes
description: Use when raw scRNA-seq read count matrices from multiple batches contain cell types that are unknown a priori, and clustering plus batch-effect correction must be performed jointly without preliminary normalization.

name: cell-type-colored-embedding-visualization
description: Use when a 2D ivis embedding of scRNA-seq data has been computed and you need to visually validate cell-type segregation and global cluster relationships against published figures.

name: cell-type-comparative-epigenomics
description: Use when CpG-level methylation calls (e.g., Roadmap WGBS) must be summarized per interval set and compared across cell types to test differential methylation level/variation between HOT regions and control regions like non-HOT CpG islands.

name: cell-type-composition-input-construction
description: Use when preparing seq-based ST data (e.g., 10X Visium slices such as the 12 human DLPFC slices) for Splane spatial domain identification, which requires per-spot cell type composition rather than gene expression.

name: cell-type-composition-quantification-across-conditions
description: Use when comparing cell-state or cell-type proportions between conditions (e.g., KO vs WT) in scRNA-seq data where cells have been projected onto a reference atlas and assigned discrete cell-state labels.

name: cell-type-composition-regression-analysis
description: Use when a single-cell/nucleus atlas has cell-type or cell-state annotations plus per-donor covariates, and the goal is to test whether cell-type fractions differ across a condition (e.g. obesity, depot) while controlling for covariates.

name: cell-type-consistency-evaluation
description: Use when comparing cell type annotation accuracy of cluster-based vs cell-based methods on scRNA-seq datasets with known reference labels, or when quantifying how swapping the underlying reference database affects annotation consistency.

name: cell-type-consistency-rate-computation
description: Use when evaluating how accurately an automatic cell-type annotation method labels clusters of scRNA-seq data against manually curated cell types, and a comparable consistent-rate table across multiple methods is needed.

name: cell-type-correlation-strategy-selection

name: cell-type-correspondence-mapping

name: cell-type-count-aggregation

name: cell-type-count-matrix-aggregation

name: cell-type-deconvolution-method-evaluation

name: cell-type-deconvolution-wnnls

name: cell-type-differential-abundance-testing

name: cell-type-differential-expression-analysis
description: Use when a single-cell dataset contains annotated cell types and two conditions, and you need per-cell-type DE gene counts and magnitudes to rank the biological response across populations.

name: cell-type-disjoint-cross-validation-splitting
description: Use when benchmarking cross-modality translation methods (e.g., scRNA-seq to scATAC-seq) for generalization to cell types absent from training, mimicking the MB/MCC/MK/PBMC unseen-cell-type evaluation.

name: cell-type-drug-response-ranking
description: Use when you need to identify which cell type in an untreated disease scRNA-seq dataset is most responsive to a drug with a known target gene, without paired treated/untreated samples.

name: cell-type-enrichment-analysis
description: Use when SINCERA hierarchical clustering has produced cell clusters and each cluster must be annotated with a predicted cell type using differentially expressed genes and a Fisher's exact test against the EBI Expression Atlas annotation table.

name: cell-type-entropy-coefficient-of-variation-benchmarking
description: Use when comparing segmentation methods on spatial transcriptomics data (e.g., MERSCOPE melanoma, CosMx lung) where no pixel-level ground truth exists and you need reference-based homogeneity vs cell-size consistency metrics.

name: cell-type-epiallele-trajectory-comparison

name: cell-type-expression-aggregation
description: Use when a scRNA-seq study stored as an AnnData/H5AD object must be loaded into a relational sparse expression table and queried for gene-level per-cell-type averages, e.g. to replicate Cellenium's server-side aggregation.

name: cell-type-expression-specificity-ranking
description: Use when a query gene of interest (e.g. 'insulin') must be matched to the annotated cell types that specifically express it, within one study or across multiple ingested scRNA-seq studies.

name: cell-type-f1-score-computation
description: Use when comparing label-transfer accuracy of scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq integration methods on cells with held-out ground-truth annotations, especially under varying annotation budgets.

name: cell-type-flux-differential-testing

name: cell-type-fraction-heatmap-visualization

name: cell-type-functional-annotation
description: Use when an unsupervised clustering (e.g., Leiden) of scRNA-seq data has produced clusters with no labels and you must assign a cell type from the functional enrichment of cluster-specific genes.

name: cell-type-gene-signature-definition

name: cell-type-ground-truth-precision-evaluation
description: Use when a real scRNA-seq dataset has trusted cell-type labels serving as ground truth and you need to quantify how precisely a gene-set or pathway score (TRS, scDRS) retrieves the trait-relevant cell type.

name: cell-type-held-out-benchmarking

name: cell-type-hierarchy-construction

name: cell-type-homology-annotation

name: cell-type-hop-distance-computation
